                                                            </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                                    <span
                                                        class="text-nowrap item-text-title">FBM占比</span>
                                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title=""
                                                        data-toggle="tooltip"
                                                        data-tips='<p>样本范围内通过FBM发货的商品数量占总样本数量的比例</p><p>比如样本100个商品中，有24个商品走FBM发货，则FBM占比 = 24/100=24%</p><p>一般来说，FBM占比越高代表竞争越小<br></p>'></span>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 d-flex align-items-center">
                                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                                            <input name="minFbmRatio" value=""
                                                                placeholder="最小值" class="form-control text-center" type="number">
                                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">％</span>
                                                            </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                                            <input name="maxFbmRatio" value=""
                                                                placeholder="最大值" class="form-control text-center" type="number">
                                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">％</span>
                                                            </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-12 col-xl-12 filter-condition">
                            <div class="card-body text-secondary">
                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <div class="h6 m-0"><strong>市场波动指标</strong></div>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title="" data-toggle="tooltip"
                                        data-tips='<p>体现新卖家进入该市场的难易程度，以及存活难度的数据维度</p><p>市场波动大往往意味着新品还有机会，但也可能因为是不成熟的市场，新品也很容易因为盈利达不到预期而出局<br></p>'></span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="row">
                                    <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4">
                                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                                    <span class="text-nowrap item-text-title">&nbsp;新品数量占比</span>
                                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title="" data-toggle="tooltip"
                                                        data-tips='<p>样本范围内，新品数量占总样本数的比例</p><p><br></p><p>可自定义新品范围，<span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>比如将新品定义为3个月内上架的商品</span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>样本100个商品中，3个月内上架的新品有15个，则新品数量占比 = 15/100=15%</span></p>'></span>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 d-flex align-items-center">
                                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                                            <input name="minNewRatio" value="" placeholder="最小值"
                                                                class="form-control text-center" type="number">
                                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">％</span>
                                                            </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                                            <input name="maxNewRatio" value="" placeholder="最大值"
                                                                class="form-control text-center" type="number">
                                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">％</span>
                                                            </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                                    <span class="text-nowrap item-text-title">&nbsp;新品平均价格</span>
                                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title="" data-toggle="tooltip"
                                                        data-tips='<p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>样本范围内，新品的平均价格</span><br></p><p><br></p><p>可自定义新品范围，比如将新品定义为3个月内上架的商品</p><p>样本100个商品中，3个月内上架的新品有2个，价格分别是<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>$15和$25</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>，则平均价格为(15+25)/2=</span><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>$</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>20</span></p>'></span>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 d-flex align-items-center">
                                                        <input name="minNewAvgPrice" class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                             onkeyup="clearNoNum(this)" type="text" placeholder="最小值"
                                                            value="">
                                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                                        <input name="maxNewAvgPrice" class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                             onkeyup="clearNoNum(this)" type="text" placeholder="最大值"
                                                            value="">
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                                    <span class="text-nowrap item-text-title" style="white-space: pre-wrap!important;max-width: 83px;">新品月均<br/>销售额</span>
                                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title=""
                                                          data-toggle="tooltip"
                                                          data-tips='<p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>样本范围内，新品的平均月销售额</span><br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;><br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>可自定义新品范围，比如将新品定义为3个月内上架的商品</p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>样本100个商品中，3个月内上架的新品有2个，月销售额分别是$3000和$4000，则平均月销售额为(3000+4000)/2=<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>$3500</span></p>'></span>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 d-flex align-items-center">
                                                        <input name="minNewAvgRevenue"
                                                               class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                               type="number" placeholder="最小值" value="">
                                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                                        <input name="maxNewAvgRevenue"
                                                               class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                               type="number" placeholder="最大值" value="">
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4">
                                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                                    <span
                                                        class="text-nowrap item-text-title">新品数量</span>
                                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title=""
                                                        data-toggle="tooltip"
                                                        data-tips='<p>样本范围内，新上架商品的数量</p><p><br></p><p>可自定义新品范围，比如将新品定义为3个月内上架的商品<br></p><p>样本100个商品中，3个月内上架的商品有15个，则新品数量为15<br></p>'></span>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 d-flex align-items-center">
                                                        <input name="minNewCount" class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                             type="number" placeholder="最小值"
                                                            value="">
                                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                                        <input name="maxNewCount" class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                             type="number" placeholder="最大值"
                                                            value="">
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                                    <span class="text-nowrap item-text-title">新品平均星级</span>
                                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title=""
                                                        data-toggle="tooltip"
                                                        data-tips='<p>样本范围内，新品的平均星级</p><p><br></p><p>可自定义新品范围，比如将新品定义为3个月内上架的商品</p><p>样本100个商品中，3个月内上架的新品有2个，评分星级分别是4.0和4.4，则平均星级为(4.0+4.4)/2=4.2</p>'></span>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 d-flex align-items-center">
                                                        <input name="minNewAvgRating"
                                                            class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                            onkeyup="clearNoNum(this)" type="text" placeholder="最小值"
                                                            value="">
                                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                                        <input name="maxNewAvgRating"
                                                            class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                            onkeyup="clearNoNum(this)" type="text" placeholder="最大值"
                                                            value="">
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4">
                                            <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                                    <span class="text-nowrap item-text-title" style="white-space: pre-wrap!important;max-width: 83px;">新品平均<br/>评分数</span>
                                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title=""
                                                        data-toggle="tooltip"
                                                        data-tips='<p>样本范围内，新品的平均评分数（Listing的ratings数量）</p><p><br></p><p>可自定义新品范围，比如将新品定义为3个月内上架的商品</p><p>样本100个商品中，3个月内上架的新品有2个，评分数分别是10和40，则平均评分数为(10+40)/2=25<br></p>'></span>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 d-flex align-items-center">
                                                        <input name="minNewAvgReviews"
                                                            class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                            type="number" placeholder="最小值" value="">
                                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                                        <input name="maxNewAvgReviews"
                                                            class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                            type="number" placeholder="最大值" value="">
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                                    <span class="text-nowrap item-text-title" style="white-space: pre-wrap!important;max-width: 83px;">新品月均销量</span>
                                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" title=""
                                                          data-toggle="tooltip"
                                                          data-tips='<p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>样本范围内，新品的平均月销量</span><br></p><p><br></p><p>可自定义新品范围，比如将新品定义为3个月内上架的商品</p><p>样本100个商品中，3个月内上架的新品有2个，月销量分别是100和230，则平均月销量为(100+230)/2=165</p>'></span>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 d-flex align-items-center">
                                                        <input name="minNewAvgSales"
                                                               class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                               type="number" placeholder="最小值" value="">
                                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                                        <input name="maxNewAvgSales"
                                                               class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"
                                                               type="number" placeholder="最大值" value="">
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                    </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <hr class="m-0">
                <div class="card-body py-5">
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="col-12 col-md-4 d-flex justify-content-center offset-md-4">

                                    class="iconfont icon-filtrate mr-1"></span>筛选市场

                            </button>

                                保存当前模式

                    <div class="table-responsive-xl u-datatable" style="overflow-x: auto;">
                        <table id="table-condition-search" class="js-freeze-header table loose-table">
                            <thead>
                                <tr class="bg-white text-secondary">
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div
                                                class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary active">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap">#</div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="1%" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div
                                                class="th d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center text-secondary">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap">细分市场
                                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                        data-tips='<p>细分市场代表商品所属的亚马逊（上架）类目</p><p><br></p><p>亚马逊各站点的类目繁多（其中美国站有超过2万的子类目），类目层级1-N层，每层向下是包含关系</p><p>相似的商品可能上架在不同的类目和路径，建议通过“<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>查竞品-关键词搜索</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>”初步确认<br><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>特别注意：所有的指标都来自于当前类目的商品，不包括下级类目</span></span></p>'></span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap">
                                                    样本数量
                                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                        data-tips='<p>商品数，代表选取的样本总数，默认取值为近30天总销量前100位的商品</p><p>品牌数，代表样本商品中，所属品牌的总数</p><p>卖家数，代表样本商品中，所属Buybox卖家的总数</p><p><br></p><p>例：商品:100 品牌:54 卖家:52</p><p>则表示该细分市场中，本次取样分析商品总数100个，这100个商品分别来自54个品牌，目前有52个Buybox卖家正在销售</p><p>*商品数小于100的原因：该细分市场较小，在售商品不足100或近期无销量，不具有参考价值，因此未收录</p><p><br></p><p><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>特别注意：商品数只属于当前类目，也就是这些样本所上架的类目，不包含下级子类目</span></p>'></span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap" style="color:
                                                    #fb8c1e" >
                                                    月总销量
                                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                        data-tips='<p>样本范围内，所有商品近30天的销量总和，该指标可侧面反映该细分市场的市场容量<br>例：(样本数量：前100），取销量前100位商品，近30天的销量之和为58000，则此项数字显示为58000</p><p><br></p><p>月总销量短期内变化剧烈？点击查看<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/data-differences-of-market-research&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>详细解释</a></p>'></span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"  >
                                                    <div>
                                                        月均销量
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div>
                                                        头部商品
                                                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                            data-tips='<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>上行-样本商品月均销量：</span>该细分市场的样本范围内，商品近30天的平均销量<br><p>例：(样本数量: 前100）销量前100位的商品近30天的总销量为55000，则月均销量为55000/100=550件<br><br><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>下行-头部商品月均销量：</span>该细分市场的样本范围内，头部商品（可自定义范围）近30天的平均销量，<br>例：(头部商品: 前10）销量前10位的商品近30天的总销量为20000，则月均销量为20000/10=2000件<br></p><p><br></p><p><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>下行-垄断度</span><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0); font-size: 1rem;&quot;>（括号内）</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit; color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>：</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>垄断度=</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>头部商品月均销量/样本商品月均销量</span></p><p>该指标用于了解细分市场的销量平均水平，亦可用于初步判断，头部商品的垄断情况；<br>比值越大，说明头部商品对市场垄断程度越高（一般来说，比值5以上，已处于相对垄断）</p>'></span>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"  >
                                                    <div>
                                                        月均销售额
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div>
                                                        头部商品
                                                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                            data-tips='<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>上行-样本商品月均销售额：</span>该细分市场的样本范围内，商品近30天的平均销售额<br><p>例：(样本数量 :前100）销量前100位的商品近30天的总销售额为55000，则月均销售额为55000/100=550<br><br><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>下行-头部商品月均销售额：</span>该细分市场的样本范围内，头部商品（可自定义范围）近30天的平均销售额<br>例：(头部商品: 前10）销量<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>前10位</span>的商品近30天的总销售额为20000，则月均销售额为20000/10=2000<br><br>该指标用于了解细分市场的销售额<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>平均水平</span>，粗略判断该细分市场的销售额规模是否符合您的预期要求<br>亦可用于初步判断，头部商品的<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>垄断情况</span>。用头部商品月均销售额除以样本商品月均销售额，得到的比值越大，说明市场垄断程度越高（一般来说，比值5以上，已处于相对垄断）<br></p>'></span>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"  >
                                                    <div>
                                                        平均评分数
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div>
                                                        平均星级
                                                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                            data-tips='<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>平均评分数：</span>该细分市场样本范围内，商品的平均评分数<br><p>例：(样本数量: 前100）销量前100件商品的总评分数为5000，则平均评分数为5000/100=50<br><br><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>平均星级：</span>该细分市场样本范围内，商品的平均星级<br>例：(样本数量: 前100）销量前100件商品的星级汇总后求平均值<br><br>平均评分数和平均星级，反映了该类目商品的<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>买家满意度水平</span><br>这两个指标还可用于侧面观察新品进入该市场，前期的<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>打造难度（市场成熟度）</span><br>对于工厂型卖家，可从买家满意度角度，观察商品可进入的空间（一般情况下，评分值低的相对好进入，3.7分为中间值；评分数取决于商品的类型和卖家的规模，需要综合考量）</p><p><br></p><p>点击了解：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-understand-avg-rating&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何通过平均评分数进行市场分析？</a></p>'></span>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"  >
                                                    <div>
                                                        平均BSR
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div>
                                                        头部商品
                                                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                            data-tips='<p><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>平均BSR：</span>该细分市场样本范围内，商品近30天的平均BSR</p><p>（<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>BSR：Best Sellers Rank，一个类目中的“最畅销”产品BSR表现为1。数值越小，表示越畅销</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>）</span></p><p>例：(样本数量: 前100）销量前100件商品近30天的BSR数值总和为5000，则平均BSR为5000/100=50<br><br><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>头部商品平均BSR：</span>该细分市场的样本范围内，头部商品（可自定义范围）近30天的平均BSR，<br>例：(头部商品: 前10）销量<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>前10位</span>商品近30天的BSR数值总和为200，则平均BSR为200/10=20<br><br>平均BSR和头部商品平均BSR比值越大，说明市场竞争越激烈</p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>头部平均BSR数值大于样本平均BSR数值？点击查看</span><a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/data-differences-of-market-research&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;font-size: inherit; color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>详细解释</a><br></p>'></span>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"  >平均卖家数
                                                    <br/>
                                                    平均价格
                                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                          data-tips='<p><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>平均卖家数：</span>该细分市场样本范围内，单件商品的平均卖家数</p><p>比如前100件商品共有200个卖家在售卖，则平均卖家数为2.0</p><p>卖家数越多说明竞争越激烈，也说明市场机会越大（Listing销售权没有被独占）</p><p><br></p><p><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>平均价格：</span>该细分市场样本范围内，单件商品的平均价格</p><p>例：(样本数量: 前100）销量前100件商品近30天价格之和为$2760，则平均价格为2760/100=$27.60</p><p><span data-lark-record-data=&quot;{&quot;rootId&quot;:&quot;Tfg5d23FnojDlCxAcpPcMHtDnMc&quot;,&quot;text&quot;:{&quot;initialAttributedTexts&quot;:{&quot;text&quot;:{&quot;0&quot;:&quot;该指标侧面反映了买家普遍接受的价格水平；也可用于粗略计算该细分市场的商品毛利&quot;},&quot;attribs&quot;:{&quot;0&quot;:&quot;*0+12&quot;}},&quot;apool&quot;:{&quot;numToAttrib&quot;:{&quot;0&quot;:[&quot;author&quot;,&quot;6959558576163536897&quot;]},&quot;nextNum&quot;:1}},&quot;type&quot;:&quot;text&quot;,&quot;referenceRecordMap&quot;:{},&quot;extra&quot;:{&quot;mention_page_title&quot;:{},&quot;external_mention_url&quot;:{}},&quot;isKeepQuoteContainer&quot;:false,&quot;isFromCode&quot;:false,&quot;selection&quot;:[{&quot;id&quot;:63,&quot;type&quot;:&quot;text&quot;,&quot;selection&quot;:{&quot;start&quot;:0,&quot;end&quot;:38},&quot;recordId&quot;:&quot;AhpedT09yocS2exU9UVc4HyTnrd&quot;}],&quot;payloadMap&quot;:{},&quot;isCut&quot;:false}&quot; data-lark-record-format=&quot;docx/text&quot; class=&quot;lark-record-clipboard&quot;></span></p><div data-page-id=&quot;Tfg5d23FnojDlCxAcpPcMHtDnMc&quot; data-docx-has-block-data=&quot;false&quot;><div style=&quot;text-align:left&quot; class=&quot;ace-line ace-line old-record-id-AhpedT09yocS2exU9UVc4HyTnrd&quot;>该指标侧面反映了买家普遍接受的价格水平；也可用于粗略计算该细分市场的商品毛利</div></div><p><br></p><p>继续阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/blog/price-logic-of-market-research&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;>选市场-产品价格背后的逻辑</a></p>'></span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"  >卖家类型
                                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                        data-tips='<p>不同卖家发货类型的商品数量占样本总商品数量的比例，分为FBA、FBM及Amazon自营发货<br>Amazon自营占比越大，说明市场进入壁垒越高</p><p><br>卖家所属地也是竞争指标，视频介绍：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/blog/sellersprite-new-function-for-seller-location&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;&quot;>点击这里</a></p>'></span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"  >集中度指标
                                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                        data-tips='<p>衡量市场竞争和垄断的指标</p><p><span style=&quot;font-weight: bold; color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>商品集中度：</span>头部商品的总销量T，占样本范围内商品总销量A的比例，即商品集中度=T/A；</p><p>比例越高，说明这个类目中，头部商品垄断越明显</p><p>例：头部商品（销量前10位）总销量为5000，样本商品（销量前100位）总销量为10000，则商品集中度为：5000/10000=50%；代表头部商品的销量占样本商品销量的50%</p><p><br></p><p><span style=&quot;font-weight: bold; color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>品牌集中度：</span>头部品牌的总销量Y，占样本范围内商品总销量A的比例，即品牌集中度=Y/A；</p><p>比例越高，说明这个类目中，品牌的垄断程度越高</p><p>例：头部品牌（销量<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>前10品牌</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>）总销量为7000，样本商品（销量前100位</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>）总销量为10000，则品牌集中度为：7000/10000=70%；代表前10大品牌的销量占样本商品销量的70%</span></p><p><br></p><p><span style=&quot;font-weight: bold; color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>卖家集中度：</span>头部卖家的总销量U，占样本范围内商品总销量A的比例，则卖家集中度=U/A；</p><p>比例越高，说明销量前10位的卖家对该类目的垄断程度越高</p><p>例：头部卖家（销量<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>前10卖家</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>）</span><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>总销量</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>为8000，样本商品（销量前100位</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>）总销量为10000，则卖家集中度为：8000/10000=80%；代表前10大卖家的销量</span><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>占样本商品销量的</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>80%</span></p><p><br></p><p>一般来说，集中度越低，竞争格局分散，越有机会突破；</p><p>推荐使用本页面“排序规则”，选择各集中度进行升序排列，快速发现<b style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>低竞争度</b>的市场</p>'></span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"  >
                                                    <div>
                                                        新品数量
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div>
                                                        新品占比
                                                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                            data-tips='<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>新品数量：</span>该细分市场样本范围内，新上架商品的数量（新品期可自定义1/3/6/12个月）<br>例：(样本数量：前100，新品定义3个月）销量前100件商品，3个月内上架的商品有15个，则新品数量为15<br><br><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>新品占比：</span>该细分市场样本范围内，新上架商品占总样本数的比例（新品期可自定义1/3/6/12个月）<br>例：(样本数量：前100，新品定义3个月）销量前100件商品，3个月内上架的商品有15个，则新品占比为15/100=15%<br><br>新品数量和占比反映了该细分市场下，新品的活跃度，可反映市场<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>新品供给情况</span><br>在市场分析报告中，结合新品的销量情况，可了解新品的市场接受度<br>一般来说，活跃度高，越有利新产品和新卖家/中小卖家的进入<br><br>同时，巧用<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>排序功能</span>（新品数量 -&gt; 降序），可以快速找出潜力市场或市场波动较大的市场，这类市场可能比较适合于中小卖家进入<br>'></span>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap" >商品总数
                                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                        data-tips='<p>亚马逊前台该类目下上架商品总数，您可以点击类目路径最后的图标进入类目主页查看<br></p><p>商品总数越大，说明该市场参与竞争的商家/商品越多</p><p><br></p><p>但由于亚马逊前台目前正在改版，部分站点通过某个商品的上架细分类目进入后会自动跳转到细分类目名称的关键词搜索结果<br></p><p>点击了解：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-distinguish-total-products-from-search-results&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;>类目商品数和搜索结果数的区别</a></p>'></span>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap" >退货率
                                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle"
                                                          data-tips='<p>数据来源于亚马逊后台的选品指南针</p><p><font color=&quot;#ff9c00&quot;>退货率：</font>最近3个月，该类目下的退货商品数量与总购买量的比值</p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span></p><p><span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>同类目均值：</span>同类型类目最近3个月的平均退货率</p><p>比如shoes类目下共有womens road running shoes、mens road running shoes等18个同类型细分类目，</p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>同类目均值</span>计算的就是这18个细分类目近3个月退货率的平均值</p><p><br></p><p>该指标可以作为选品初期计算产品利润率时的参考，</p><p>还可以对比自己的退货率，如果高于行业退货率，则需要及时找出原因进行调整</p><p><br></p><p>扩展阅读：<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;><a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/refund-rate-analysis&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;>类目退货率在选品运营中的应用</a></span><span style=&quot;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 0);&quot;></span></p>'></span>
                                                    <br/>
                                                    同类目均值
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                    <th width="" scope="col">
                                        <div class="bg-light">
                                            <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">
                                                <div class="text-nowrap"> 操作</div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                <tr class="bg-white">
                                        <td class="align-middle">
                                            <div class="td text-muted">
                                                21</div>
                                        </td>

            </div>

                        id="customModalCancelBtn"

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">
    <div class="custom-modal-wrapper">
        <div class="custom-modal-dialog" id="customModalDialog">
            <!-- å³é­æé® -->
            <div class="custom-close-icon" onclick="CustomModal.close()">
                <img class="close-icon-img" src="/assets/img/circle-close.svg" alt="">
                <img class="close-icon-img-hover" src="/assets/img/circle-close-hover.svg" alt="">
            </div>
            <!-- é¡¶é¨å¾ç -->
            <div class="modal-top-image" id="customModalTopImageWrapper" style="display:none;">
                <img id="customModalTopImage" src="" alt="top-image">
            </div>
            <!-- åå®¹åºå -->
            <div class="modal-content-guide">
                <div class="modal-text-guide" id="customModalContent"></div>
            </div>
            <!-- åºé¨æé® -->
            <div class="modal-footer-guide" id="customModalFooter">
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

            </div>

                        id="customModalCancelBtn"

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">
    <div class="custom-modal-wrapper">

            <!-- å³é­æé® -->

            </div>

            </div>

                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>
