<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">
    <div class="custom-modal-wrapper">
        <div class="custom-modal-dialog" id="customModalDialog">
            <!-- å³é­æé® -->
            <div class="custom-close-icon" onclick="CustomModal.close()">
                <img class="close-icon-img" src="/assets/img/circle-close.svg" alt="">
                <img class="close-icon-img-hover" src="/assets/img/circle-close-hover.svg" alt="">
            </div>
            <!-- é¡¶é¨å¾ç -->
            <div class="modal-top-image" id="customModalTopImageWrapper" style="display:none;">
                <img id="customModalTopImage" src="" alt="top-image">
            </div>
            <!-- åå®¹åºå -->
            <div class="modal-content-guide">
                <div class="modal-text-guide" id="customModalContent"></div>
            </div>
            <!-- åºé¨æé® -->
            <div class="modal-footer-guide" id="customModalFooter">
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">
    <div class="custom-modal-wrapper">
        <div class="custom-modal-dialog" id="customModalDialog">
            <!-- å³é­æé® -->
            <div class="custom-close-icon" onclick="CustomModal.close()">
                <img class="close-icon-img" src="/assets/img/circle-close.svg" alt="">
                <img class="close-icon-img-hover" src="/assets/img/circle-close-hover.svg" alt="">
            </div>
            <!-- é¡¶é¨å¾ç -->
            <div class="modal-top-image" id="customModalTopImageWrapper" style="display:none;">
                <img id="customModalTopImage" src="" alt="top-image">
            </div>
            <!-- åå®¹åºå -->

                <div class="modal-text-guide" id="customModalContent"></div>
            </div>
            <!-- åºé¨æé® -->
            <div class="modal-footer-guide" id="customModalFooter">
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

</div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

            </div>

                        id="customModalCancelBtn"

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

  }
  .spoke {
      position: absolute;
      width: var(--spoke-base-length);
      height: 2px;
      background-color: currentColor; 
      border-radius: 1px; 
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(var(--angle)) translateX(var(--spoke-offset));
      opacity: 1; 
  }
  .spoke:nth-child(1) { --angle: 0deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(2) { --angle: 45deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(3) { --angle: 90deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(4) { --angle: 135deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(5) { --angle: 180deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(6) { --angle: 225deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(7) { --angle: 270deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(8) { --angle: 315deg; }
  @keyframes spin-container {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  }
  .small .spoke {
      height: 1px; 
  }
  .ai-guide-tips{
      position: absolute;
      right: 30px;
      top: -42px;
      display: none;
      width: 390px;
      height: 98px;
  }
  .ai-guide-tips.en{
    width: 440px;
  }

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">
    <div class="custom-modal-wrapper">
        <div class="custom-modal-dialog" id="customModalDialog">
            <!-- å³é­æé® -->
            <div class="custom-close-icon" onclick="CustomModal.close()">
                <img class="close-icon-img" src="/assets/img/circle-close.svg" alt="">
                <img class="close-icon-img-hover" src="/assets/img/circle-close-hover.svg" alt="">
            </div>
            <!-- é¡¶é¨å¾ç -->
            <div class="modal-top-image" id="customModalTopImageWrapper" style="display:none;">
                <img id="customModalTopImage" src="" alt="top-image">
            </div>
            <!-- åå®¹åºå -->
            <div class="modal-content-guide">
                <div class="modal-text-guide" id="customModalContent"></div>
            </div>
            <!-- åºé¨æé® -->
            <div class="modal-footer-guide" id="customModalFooter">
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

            </div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

      height: 16px;
      /*margin-right: 4px;*/
  }
  
  .radiating-spinner {
      --spinner-base-size: 14px; 
      --spoke-base-length: 4px;
      --spoke-base-offset: 5px; 
  }
  .spoke {
      --spoke-offset: var(--spoke-base-offset);
      color: rgb(69,87,234)
  }
  .radiating-spinner {
      position: relative;
      width: var(--spinner-base-size);
      height: var(--spinner-base-size);
      animation: spin-container 1.2s linear infinite;
  }
  .spoke {
      position: absolute;
      width: var(--spoke-base-length);
      height: 2px;
      background-color: currentColor; 
      border-radius: 1px; 
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(var(--angle)) translateX(var(--spoke-offset));
      opacity: 1; 
  }
  .spoke:nth-child(1) { --angle: 0deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(2) { --angle: 45deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(3) { --angle: 90deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(4) { --angle: 135deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(5) { --angle: 180deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(6) { --angle: 225deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(7) { --angle: 270deg; }
  .spoke:nth-child(8) { --angle: 315deg; }
  @keyframes spin-container {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  }
  .small .spoke {
      height: 1px; 
  }
  .ai-guide-tips{
      position: absolute;
      right: 30px;
      top: -42px;
      display: none;
      width: 390px;
      height: 98px;
  }
  .ai-guide-tips.en{
    width: 440px;
  }
