<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">
    <div class="custom-modal-wrapper">
        <div class="custom-modal-dialog" id="customModalDialog">
            <!-- å³é­æé® -->
            <div class="custom-close-icon" onclick="CustomModal.close()">
                <img class="close-icon-img" src="/assets/img/circle-close.svg" alt="">
                <img class="close-icon-img-hover" src="/assets/img/circle-close-hover.svg" alt="">
            </div>
            <!-- é¡¶é¨å¾ç -->
            <div class="modal-top-image" id="customModalTopImageWrapper" style="display:none;">
                <img id="customModalTopImage" src="" alt="top-image">
            </div>
            <!-- åå®¹åºå -->
            <div class="modal-content-guide">
                <div class="modal-text-guide" id="customModalContent"></div>
            </div>
            <!-- åºé¨æé® -->
            <div class="modal-footer-guide" id="customModalFooter">
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">

            <!-- å³é­æé® -->

            </div>

            <div class="modal-top-image" id="customModalTopImageWrapper" style="display:none;">
                <img id="customModalTopImage" src="" alt="top-image">
            </div>
            <!-- åå®¹åºå -->

            </div>

            <div class="modal-footer-guide" id="customModalFooter">
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">
    <div class="custom-modal-wrapper">
        <div class="custom-modal-dialog" id="customModalDialog">
            <!-- å³é­æé® -->

                <img class="close-icon-img" src="/assets/img/circle-close.svg" alt="">
                <img class="close-icon-img-hover" src="/assets/img/circle-close-hover.svg" alt="">
            </div>
            <!-- é¡¶é¨å¾ç -->
            <div class="modal-top-image" id="customModalTopImageWrapper" style="display:none;">
                <img id="customModalTopImage" src="" alt="top-image">
            </div>
            <!-- åå®¹åºå -->

                <div class="modal-text-guide" id="customModalContent"></div>
            </div>
            <!-- åºé¨æé® -->
            <div class="modal-footer-guide" id="customModalFooter">
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®

        </div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">
    <div class="custom-modal-wrapper">
        <div class="custom-modal-dialog" id="customModalDialog">
            <!-- å³é­æé® -->
            <div class="custom-close-icon" onclick="CustomModal.close()">
                <img class="close-icon-img" src="/assets/img/circle-close.svg" alt="">
                <img class="close-icon-img-hover" src="/assets/img/circle-close-hover.svg" alt="">
            </div>
            <!-- é¡¶é¨å¾ç -->
            <div class="modal-top-image" id="customModalTopImageWrapper" style="display:none;">
                <img id="customModalTopImage" src="" alt="top-image">
            </div>
            <!-- åå®¹åºå -->
            <div class="modal-content-guide">
                <div class="modal-text-guide" id="customModalContent"></div>
            </div>
            <!-- åºé¨æé® -->
            <div class="modal-footer-guide" id="customModalFooter">
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalCancelBtn"
                        class="custom-btn">
                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"
                        id="customModalConfirmBtn"
                        class="custom-btn custom-btn-primary">
                    ç¡®å®
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

<script>

    const isCustomDepartment = '' === 'true';

    if (isCustomDepartment && !window.aiCLAiGuideTimer) {
        window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                clearInterval(window.aiCLAiGuideTimer);
                window.aiCLAiGuideTimer = null;
                if(!window.localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide')) {
                    openMarketAiGuideModal();
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }

    if (!window.aiMarketGuideTimer) {
        window.aiMarketGuideTimer = setInterval(function () {
            if ($('#table-condition-search').length > 0) {
                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);
                }
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    
    function hadLookGuide(){
        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide()
    }
    function openMarketAiGuideModal() {
        console.log('openMarketAiGuideModal');
        var lang = "cn";
        var contentText;
        var cancelText;
        var confirmText;
        if (lang === 'jp') {
            contentText = '【AI-リサーチ商品リサーチ】が高精度の競合リスト構築をサポートし、市場分析をより正確に';
            confirmText = '使ってみる'; 
        } else if (lang === 'en') {
            contentText = 'Competitor AI Insights helps you build a precise competitor list, making your market analysis truly reliable.';
            confirmText = 'Try Now';
        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({
            width: '398px',
            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',
            showFooter: true,
            showCancelButton: false,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            cancelButtonText: cancelText,
            confirmButtonText: confirmText,
            confirmButtonType: 'primary',
            onConfirm: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                window.open('/v3/ai-history?module=CL', '_blank');
                localStorage.getItem('closeCLAiGuide');
                CustomModal.close();
            },
            onCancel: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
            }
        });
        setTimeout(()=>{
             try {
                    localStorage.setItem('closeCLAiGuide', true);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('setItem failed', e);
                }
                CustomModal.close();
        },3000)
    }

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

<div id="customModalMask" class="custom-modal-mask">

            <!-- å³é­æé® -->

            </div>

                        id="customModalCancelBtn"

                    åæ¶
                </button>
                <button type="button"

<script>
  var CustomModal = (function() {
      var $mask = $('#customModalMask');
      var $dialog = $('#customModalDialog');
      var $topImageWrapper = $('#customModalTopImageWrapper');
      var $topImage = $('#customModalTopImage');
      var $content = $('#customModalContent');
      var $footer = $('#customModalFooter');
      var $cancelBtn = $('#customModalCancelBtn');
      var $confirmBtn = $('#customModalConfirmBtn');

      var onCancelFn = null;
      var onConfirmFn = null;
      var closeOnClickModal = true;

      // ç¹å»é®ç½©å³é­
      $mask.on('click', function (e) {
          if (!closeOnClickModal) return;
          if (e.target === this) { // åªå¨ç¹å»é®ç½©å±æ¬èº«æ¶å³é­
              CustomModal.close();
          }
      });

      return {
          open: function(options) {
              options = options || {};
              // å®½åº¦
              var width = options.width || '500px';
              $dialog.css('width', width);

              // é¡¶é¨å¾ç
              if (options.topImage) {
                  $topImage.attr('src', options.topImage);
                  $topImageWrapper.show();
              } else {
                  $topImageWrapper.hide();
              }

              // åå®¹ï¼æ¯æ HTMLï¼
              if (options.content) {
                  $content.html(options.content);
              } else {
                  $content.html('');
              }

              // åºé¨æ¾ç¤ºæ§å¶
              var showFooter = (options.showFooter === false) ? false : true;
              var showCancelButton = (options.showCancelButton === false) ? false : true;
              var showConfirmButton = (options.showConfirmButton === false) ? false : true;

              if (showFooter && (showCancelButton || showConfirmButton)) {
                  $footer.show();
                  // æé®æ¾ç¤º/éè
                  if (showCancelButton) {
                      $cancelBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $cancelBtn.hide();
                  }
                  if (showConfirmButton) {
                      $confirmBtn.show();
                  } else {
                      $confirmBtn.hide();
                  }

                  // æ ¹æ®æé®æ°éè®¾ç½®å¸å±
                  if (showCancelButton && showConfirmButton) {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('one-button')
                          .addClass('two-buttons');
                  } else {
                      $footer
                          .removeClass('two-buttons')
                          .addClass('one-button');
                  }
              } else {
                  $footer.hide();
              }

              // æé®æå­
              $cancelBtn.text(options.cancelButtonText || 'åæ¶');
              $confirmBtn.text(options.confirmButtonText || 'ç¡®å®');

              // ç¡®è®¤æé®æ ·å¼
              $confirmBtn
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-primary')
                  .removeClass('custom-btn-default');
              if (options.confirmButtonType === 'primary' || !options.confirmButtonType) {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-primary');
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.addClass('custom-btn-default');
              }

              // å è½½ç¶æ
              if (options.confirmLoading) {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', true);
              } else {
                  $confirmBtn.attr('disabled', false);
              }

              // ç¹å»é®ç½©æ¯å¦å³é­
              closeOnClickModal = options.closeOnClickModal !== false;

              // äºä»¶åè°
              onCancelFn = typeof options.onCancel === 'function' ? options.onCancel : null;
              onConfirmFn = typeof options.onConfirm === 'function' ? options.onConfirm : null;

              // ç»å®æé®äºä»¶ï¼æ¯æ¬¡éæ°ç»å®ï¼é²æ­¢éå¤ï¼
              $cancelBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onCancelFn) {
                      onCancelFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });
              $confirmBtn.off('click').on('click', function() {
                  if (onConfirmFn) {
                      onConfirmFn();
                  }
                  CustomModal.close();
              });

              // æ¾ç¤ºå¼¹çª
              $mask.css('display', 'flex');
          },

          close: function() {
              $mask.hide();
              $content.html('');
              onCancelFn = null;
              onConfirmFn = null;
          }
      };
  })();
</script><style>

                    openMarketAiGuideModal();

                    clearInterval(window.aiMarketGuideTimer);
                    window.aiMarketGuideTimer = null;

                if (window.localStorage.getItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew')) {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.ai-guide-tips').show();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.localStorage.setItem('closeMarketAiGuideNew', true);
                        $('.ai-guide-tips').hide();
                    }, 10000);

        } else {
            contentText = '【AI-找竞品】助您精准搭建竞品库，让市场分析回归真实。';
            confirmText = '去使用';
        }

        CustomModal.open({

            topImage: '/assets/img/ai/ai-CL-guide-cn-3.png',
            content: '<div>' + contentText + '</div>',

    var goToMarketAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();
        const nodeIdPath = $el.data('nodeidpath');
        const marketId = $el.data('marketid');
        const t = $el.data('topn');
        const nrn = $el.data('newreleasenum');
        const m = $el.data('currentmonth');

        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/market-research/report/ai-analysis/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath,
            data: {
                "t": t,
                "m": m,
                "nrn": nrn,
                "c": '' === 'true'
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                // 请求成功后打开新窗口
                window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
    var getNewTime = function(){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                    const quota = res.data;
                    const lang = "cn"
                    if(lang === 'jp'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '本日残り' + quota +'回');
                    }else if(lang === 'en'){
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', 'Remaining today:' + quota);
                    }else{
                        $('.show-last-time').attr('title', '当天剩余' + quota +'次');
                    }
                    $('.show-last-time').tooltip('dispose').tooltip();
            }
        })
    }
</script></div>

    <script>
    function getChangePagelink(event){
        changePageTips($(event.target),1)
    }
    function getChangePagelinkSure(){
        let _v = $(event.target).parents(".pager-pages").find(".pager-def-inputs"),val = _v.val();
        if(val != '' && !isNaN(val)){
            changePageTips(_v,2)
        }
    }
    function changePageTips($event,type){
        let maxPage =parseInt($event.attr("max")),isMaxTips = parseInt($event.attr("data-isMax"))||0,
        val = $event.val(),tips="当前数据共"+ maxPage +"页";
        pagination_url =$event.attr("data-url") ,pager_size = $event.attr("data-size");
          if(maxPage < val){
            if(isMaxTips){
                $event.attr('title', tips).attr('data-content', tips).popover('show');
                setTimeout(function () {
                    $event.attr('data-content', '')
                }, 800);
            }
            val = maxPage
            $event.val(maxPage)
          }
        if(type == 1){
            if(event.keyCode == 13 && val.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/gm,'') && !isNaN(val) && maxPage >= val){
                window.location.href=pagination_url+'size='+ pager_size +'&page=' + val.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/gm,'');
            }
        }else{
            window.location.href=pagination_url+'size='+ pager_size +'&page=' + val.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/gm,'');
        }
    }

</script>

<script>
    // 初始化 popover
    function fInitPopover($targets) {
        $targets.each(function (index, ele) {
            var $ele = $(ele);
            $ele.popover({ 'trigger': 'manual', delay: { show: 500 } }).on('mouseenter', function () {
                var _this = this;   // 这里的this触发的dom,需要存起来 否则在下面 .popover的逻辑中this会变为弹出的dom
                $(this).popover("show");
                $(".popover").on("mouseleave", function () {
                    $(_this).popover('hide');
                });
            }).on('mouseleave', function () {
                var _this = this;
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!$(".popover:hover").length) {
                        $(_this).popover("hide");
                    }
                }, 300);
            });
        });
    }
    function reduceTheNumberOfExport($target) {
        //减少导出次数
        try {
            var export_remain_num = $target.attr('export_remain_num');
            if (export_remain_num) {
                var num = parseInt(export_remain_num, 10),
                tips = "您今日的导出次数已使用完，请待明日恢复次数后，再导出";
                if ("com.iyunya.rank.dao.vo.ClientSearchVO@7b945511" === "" || ("S" === "G" && "N" !== "Y")){
                    tips = '您是免费用户，<a href="/cn/price" style="border-bottom:1px dashed #FB8C1E" target="_blank">升级套餐</a>后即可导出';
                    num = 1;
                }
                num = num - 1;
                if (num <= 0) {
                    num = 0;
                    $target[0].classList.add('disabled')
                }else{
                    var temp = $target.attr('data-template');
                    if (temp) {
                        tips = temp.replace(/#num#/ig, num);
                    }
                }
                $target.attr('export_remain_num', num);
                $target.attr('data-tips', tips);
                $target.attr('title', tips);
                $target.attr('data-original-title', tips);
                $target.popover('dispose');
                $target.each(tips_popover);
            }
        } catch (error) {

        }
        //减少导出次数
    }

        }else{
            $("input[name='exportGkImages']").val(false) 
            tips+='<br><div class="custom-control custom-checkbox  mr-3 checkbox-grid-export-3rd-picture"><input type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" id="checkbox-grid-export-3rd-picture"/><label for="checkbox-grid-export-3rd-picture" class="custom-control-label cursor-pointer-item">导出前3产品图</label></div>'
        }
        $target.attr('data-tips', tips);
        $target.popover('dispose');
        $target.each(tips_popover);  
        $target.popover("show")
    })
    $('body').on('mouseenter','button.btn-export-picture',function (){
        $target=$(this)
        var tips = $target.attr('data-original-title');
        if(!tips){
            return

        if(window.localStorage.getItem('export-picture')=='true'){

        }else{
            tips+='<br><div class="custom-control custom-checkbox  mr-3 checkbox-grid-export-picture"><input type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" id="checkbox-grid-export-picture"/><label for="checkbox-grid-export-picture" class="custom-control-label cursor-pointer-item">导出产品主图</label></div>'
        }
        $target.attr('data-tips', tips);
        $target.popover('dispose');
        $target.each(tips_popover);

    })

    function deleteBanner(open){
        $.ajax({
            url:"/v2/fragment/already-guide",
            method:"post",
            dataType: 'json',
        })
        if(open){
            $("#quick-guide-play-video-player-modal").modal("show")
        }
        let next=$(".teach-banner").next()
        let prev=$(".teach-banner").prev()
        next.removeClass("margin-padding-top-0")
        prev.removeClass("margin-padding-bottom-0")
        $(".teach-banner").remove()
       
    }
    function addBanner(){
        let show= $("input[name='show-banner']").val() == "true" ? true : false;
            //在指定位置后添加
            if(show){
            $(".test-banner").after('<div class="teach-banner container">'+
                '<i></i>'+
                '<div class="d-flex align-items-center">'+
                '<span>还不知道如何入手？快花1分钟，看看新用户指引视频吧~ </span>'+
                '<span class="banner-link d-flex align-items-center" onclick="deleteBanner(true)">'+
                '<img src="/assets-v2/img/zhibo@3x.png" alt="" style="width: 14px; height: 12px;">'+
                '<span style="margin-left:4px;">立即观看</span>'+
                '</span> </div> <i class="iconfont icon-shanchu banner-delet" onclick="deleteBanner()"></i></div>'
            )
            let next=$(".teach-banner").next()
            let prev=$(".teach-banner").prev()
            next.addClass("margin-padding-top-0")
            prev.addClass("margin-padding-bottom-0")
            }
        }

    //快速入门引导
    function newbieLocalStorage(newbie_switch, beginner_guide) {
        newbie_switch = newbie_switch ? newbie_switch : false;
        if (window.localStorage) {
            let itemLen = window.localStorage.getItem(beginner_guide);
            if (!newbie_switch) {
                return itemLen;
            } else {
                window.localStorage.setItem(beginner_guide, newbie_switch);
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    /**
     * 全局场景化提示
     */
    //处理场景式提示
        function handleSceneTips(){
            if ($('#scene_tips').length < 1) return false;
            var jsonStr = $.trim($('#scene_tips').html());
            if(jsonStr && "null" != jsonStr){
                var sceneTip = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
                let content = sceneTip.content;
                let id = sceneTip.id;
                let uri = "'"+ sceneTip.uri + "'";
                let dataTipsContent = '<div class="font-size-12 plr-2">'+ content +'<div class="mt-2 text-right"><a href="javascript:;" onclick="sceneTipsRead('+ id +","+ uri +')" class="i-got-it font-size-12">朕知道了</a></div></div>';
                let sceneTipsUriClass = "." + sceneTip.uri;
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).attr("data-tips",dataTipsContent);
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).each(tips_popover)
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).popover("show");
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).on('hide.bs.popover', function () {
                    $this = $(this);
                    if(content){
                        setTimeout(function () {
                                $this.popover("show")
                        }, 0);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        handleSceneTips();
        /**
         * @description: 新手引导
         * @param {number} 
         * @return {viod} 
         */
        function handleSetSceneTips(tipIndex=0){
            if ($('#set_of_scene_tips').length < 1) return false;
            let jsonStr = $.trim($('#set_of_scene_tips').html());
            if(jsonStr && "null" != jsonStr){
                let sceneTips = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
                let sceneTip = sceneTips[tipIndex];
                if(!sceneTip) return false
                let content = sceneTip.content;
                let id = sceneTip.id;
                let uri = "'"+ sceneTip.uri + "'";
                let nextTipIndex = tipIndex+1;
                let dataTipsContent = '<div class="font-size-12 plr-2">'+ content +'<div class="mt-2 text-right"><a href="javascript:;" onclick="sceneTipsReadNext('+ id +","+ uri +","+nextTipIndex+')" class="i-got-it font-size-12">朕知道了</a></div></div>';
                let sceneTipsUriClass = "." + sceneTip.uri;
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).attr("data-tips",dataTipsContent);
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).each(tips_popover)
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).popover("show");
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).on('hide.bs.popover', function () {
                    $this = $(this);
                    if(content){
                        setTimeout(function () {
                                $this.popover("show")
                        }, 0);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        handleSetSceneTips()
    // 获取导出次数
    function getRemainExportNum() {
        $("button.remainExportNum-btn").each(function() {
            const $btn = $(this);
            let module = $btn.attr('data-module') || 'NEBD';
            console.log(module, 'module')
            $.ajax({
                type: 'GET',
                url: '/v2/common/remain-export-num/' + module,
                dataType: 'json',
                success: (result) => {
                    if (result.code === 'OK') {
                        let num = result.data * 1 + 1;
                        $btn.attr('export_remain_num', num);
                        reduceTheNumberOfExport($btn);
                    }
                },
                error: (xhr, status, err) => {
                    console.error(module + '剩余次数请求失败:', err);
                }
            });
        });
    }

</script>

<script>
    function fInitFirebaseTopics() {
        const system = "SS_CN".toLowerCase();
        const role = "N".toUpperCase();
        const cqml = "STANDARD".toUpperCase();
        const city = "浙江杭州".toUpperCase();
        if (role === 'R' || role === 'Y') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-admin');
        else if (role === 'SP') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-super-agent');
        else if (role === 'S') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-sub');
        else window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-parent');

        if (system.indexOf('cn') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-CN');
        else if (system.indexOf('jp') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-JP');
        else if (system.indexOf('en') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-EN');
        // 推送注册国家
        if (system.indexOf('cn') < 0) city && city.indexOf('|') > 0 && window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push(city.substr(0, 2));

        if (cqml != null && cqml.length > 1) {
            let _ml = "ML-" + cqml;
            window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push(_ml);
            window.FIREBASE_TOPIC_MEMBER_LEVEL = _ml;
        }
    }fInitFirebaseTopics();
</script>
<script>
    function axisPointerFormatter(params) {
        var value = Number(params.value);
        if (isNaN(value)) {
            return params.value;
        }
        if (value <= 1.0) {
            return value.toFixed(2);
        } else {
            return value.toFixed(0);
        }
    }
</script>

<!-- Clarity handler -->
<script>
    function trackClarityEvent(eventName, tags = {}) {
        if(!window.clarity) return

        Object.keys(tags).forEach(key => {
            window.clarity("set", key, String(tags[key]))
        })

        window.clarity("event", eventName)
    }

<script>
    // 显示弹窗
    var currentUri = '/v2/market-research';
    // 中文环境
    var isZh = true;
    // 路由命中
    var isMatchedCurrentUri = ['/v2/market-research', '/v2/keyword-research', '/v2/aba/reverse/search'].some(s => s.indexOf(currentUri) > -1);
    // 登录成功
    var isLogin = Number('435722') > 0;
    // 免费会员
    var isFreeMember = 'S' === 'G';

    // 是否是管理员
    var isAdmin = ['Y', 'A2', 'R'].includes('N')

    console.log('路由命中：', isMatchedCurrentUri, ' 是否登录：', isLogin, ' 是否为免费会员（简单判断）：', isFreeMember, ' 是否为管理员：', isAdmin)

    function shouldShowDialog (lastViewTime){
        let currentTime = new Date().getTime();
        const fiveMinutes = 5 * 60 * 1000;
        return !lastViewTime || (currentTime - Number(lastViewTime) >= fiveMinutes);
    }

    // 路由命中、且已登录
    if (isLogin && isMatchedCurrentUri) {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/v3/api/popup/push-status',
            method: 'get',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function (res) {
                // 5分钟拦截
                let popViewModal = localStorage.getItem('popViewModal');
                let flag = shouldShowDialog(popViewModal)
                if(!flag) {
                    return;
                }
                // 使用新的判断逻辑
                openDirectionalWechatModal(res);
                return;

                var showWechatDialog = res && (res.data || false)
                if (showWechatDialog) {
                    $.ajax({
                        url: '/v3/api/client/valid-pay-status',
                        method: 'GET',
                        dataType: 'json',
                        success: function(payStatusRes) {
                            $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            // $('body').css({ overflow: 'hidden !important' })
                            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                            let isAdmin = false
                            if(isAdmin){
                                $.ajax({
                                    url: '/v2/common/wechat/qr?scene=after_ext_login',
                                    method: 'GET',
                                    dataType: 'json',
                                    success:function(qrData){
                                        // 有效付费用户
                                        if (payStatusRes && payStatusRes.data) {
                                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                                        } else {
                                            $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                            $('[data-free-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                                        }
                                    }
                                })
                            }else{
                                if (payStatusRes && payStatusRes.data) {
                                    $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                } else {
                                    $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})

                                }
                            }

                           
                        }
                    })
                }
            }
        })
    }

    // 新的打开弹窗逻辑
    function openDirectionalWechatModal(res) {
        if (res) {
            var data = res.data || {};
            var showWechatDialog = data.allowPush === 'Y' && ['Y', 'N'].includes(data.paidUser);

            if (showWechatDialog) {
                $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'flex'})
                // $('body').css({ overflow: 'hidden !important' })
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                $.ajax({
                    url: '/v2/common/wechat/qr?scene=after_ext_login',
                    method: 'GET',
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success:function(qrData){
                        // 有效付费用户
                        if (data.paidUser === 'Y') {
                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                        } else if (data.paidUser === 'N') {
                            $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            // $('[data-free-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                        }
                    }
                })

                        
             
            }
        }
    }

    // 关闭弹窗
    $('[data-directional-wechat-close]').click(function () {
        $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('body').css({ overflow: '' })
    })
</script>
