        <input type="hidden" id="surveyId" />
        <input type="hidden" id="answer" />
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header align-items-center">
                <div class="h4 modal-title" id="myModalLabel">
                    问卷调查 - 倾听您的声音，改进您的体验
                </div>
                <button id="btn-modal-close" type="button" class="close"> <span
                        class="iconfont icon-close-icon"></span></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body d-flex justify-content-center scroll-show-auto" id="surveyContent">
            </div>
            <div class="footer-box">
                <button id="submitSurvey" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">
                    <i class="iconfont icon-icon_function_tijiaoshenhe mr-1"></i>我要交卷</button>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    let url="";
    let surveyCodeIn = "";
    let surveyViewModal = $('#surveyViewModal');
    let sType = "";
    function isMobile() {
        var userAgentInfo = navigator.userAgent;
        var mobileAgents = ["Android", "iPhone", "SymbianOS", "Windows Phone", "iPad", "iPod"];
        var mobile_flag = false;
        for (var v = 0; v < mobileAgents.length; v++) {
            if (userAgentInfo.indexOf(mobileAgents[v]) > 0) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        var screen_width = window.screen.width;
        var screen_height = window.screen.height;
        if (screen_width < 500 && screen_height < 800) {
            mobile_flag = true;
        }
        return mobile_flag;
    }
    var SURVEY_KEY = "SURVEY_KEY_ITEM";
    var item = localStorage.getItem(SURVEY_KEY);
    var lastLoginTime = '1787960561000';
    var surveyed = item != null && item === lastLoginTime;

    // if ('MR' && !isMobile() && lastLoginTime && !surveyed) {
    //     getSurvey();
    // }
    var timeoutId = null;
    function shouldShowDialog (lastViewTime){
        let currentTime = new Date().getTime();
        const fiveMinutes = 5 * 60 * 1000;
        return !lastViewTime || (currentTime - Number(lastViewTime) >= fiveMinutes);
    }
    timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
        let popViewModal = localStorage.getItem('popViewModal');
        let flag = shouldShowDialog(popViewModal)
        if(!flag) return;
        if ('MR' && !isMobile() && lastLoginTime && !surveyed) {
            getSurvey();
        }
    },1500)
    function getSurvey(surveyCode) {
        surveyCodeIn = surveyCode || '';
        $.ajax({
            type: "get",
            url: "/v2/survey/getSurvey?scope=MR&language=CN&surveyCode=" + surveyCodeIn,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (data) {
                if (data && data.code === 1){
                    localStorage.setItem(SURVEY_KEY, lastLoginTime);
                }

                if (data.code === 1 && data.data) {
                    data.data.qaUrl?url=data.data.qaUrl:''
                    var survey = data.data;
                    sType = survey.surveyType;
                    $("#surveyId").val(survey.id);
                    if (survey.surveyType === "C") {//单选题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div><div class="custom-control custom-checkbox custom-radio label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + ' id="answerItem_' + i + '"  type="radio" class="custom-control-input" >' +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label">' +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value +
                                '</label></div></div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);
                    } else if (survey.surveyType === "P") {// 多选题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle ' + surveyCodeIn + '">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        html += '<div><div id="pcheckbox">'
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div class="custom-control custom-checkbox label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input type="checkbox" name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + '   class="custom-control-input pinput" >'
                                +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label plabel">'
                                +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value
                                +
                                '</label></div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);

                        $(".plabel").on('click', function (e) { //给label添加事件
                            if ($(".pinput").checked) { //由于点击label的时候，还没有告诉checkbo改变状态，所以当前值是false，执行else语句
                                $(".pinput").checked = false //置为false
                            } else {
                                $(".pinput").checked = true //所以这个时候checkbox应该变成了true，状态改变成功！
                            }
                        });
                    }else if (survey.surveyType === "A") {//问答题
                        $("#surveyContent").html('<div class="survey-inputform-box"><div class="surveyTitle text-center">' + survey.title + '</div><div>' +
                            '<input  class="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input" style="margin:0 auto" required type="text" id="inputAnswer" placeholder="在这里输入答案"/>' +
                            '</div></div>')
                    } else if (survey.surveyType === "M") {//复合题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle '+ surveyCodeIn + '">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div><div class="custom-control custom-checkbox custom-radio label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + ' id="answerItem_' + i + '"  type="radio" class="custom-control-input" >' +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label">' +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value +
                                '</label></div>';
                                if(items[i].key == 'O'){
                                    html += '<div style="padding-left:28px"><input  class="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input input_otherReason mb-2" required type="text" id="otherReason" placeholder="在这里输入"/></div>';
                                }
                                if(items[i].key == 'Q'){
                                    let form=document.createElement('form')
                                    form.className="input_otherReason_OO"
                                    form.id="input_otherReason_OO"
                                    let content=items[i].content
                                    for (let index = 0; index < content.length; index++) {
                                        const element = content[index];
                                        if(element.type=="text"){
                                          let div=document.createElement("div")
                                          let input=document.createElement("input")
                                          let label=document.createElement("label")
                                          label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                          input.name=element.label
                                          input.placeholder="请输入"
                                          input.required=element.require
                                          input.className="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input mb-2"
                                          div.append(label)
                                          div.append(input)
                                          form.append(div)
                                        }else if(element.type="option"){
                                            if(element.multiple){
                                                let div=document.createElement("div")
                                                let html=
                                                `<div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                                    <input name="`+element.label+`" value="" `+(element.require?'required':'') +` type="hidden" id="categorys" placeholder="请选择">
                                                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                                    <div class="form-control form-control-sm dimension-type category-custorm-css">
                                                        <span class="lable-category">请选择</span>
                                                        <select disabled class="select-category"></select>
                                                        <div class="category-Objbox">
                                                        <div class="category-box">
                                                       
                                                        </div><div class="mb-1 scroll-show-dimension scroll-show-auto" id="category-box-cotent">`
                                                        for (let j = 0; j < element.options.length; j++) {
                                                            const item = element.options[j];
                                                            html+=`
                                                            <div class="custom-control custom-checkbox mr-2 mb-2" >        
                                                                <input value=`+item+` type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input categoryTypesCheck">     
                                                                <label class="custom-control-label font-12">`+item+`</label>   
                                                            </div>`
                                                        }
                                                        html+=`</div><div class="text-center mt-2">
                                                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary pt-1 pb-1 add-category">确定</button>
                                                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-secondary ml-5 pt-1 pb-1 clear-category">清除</button></div>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>`
                                                div.innerHTML=html
                                                let label=document.createElement("label")
                                                label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                                form.append(label)
                                                form.append(div)
                                            }else{
                                                let select=document.createElement("select")
                                                let label=document.createElement("label")
                                                let div=document.createElement("div")
                                                let option=document.createElement("option")
                                                option.textContent="不限"
                                                option.value=""
                                                option.selected=true
                                                select.name=element.label
                                                select.required=element.require
                                                select.placeholder="请选择"
                                                select.className="form-control form-control-sm"
                                                label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                                select.append(option)
                                                div.append(label)
                                                for (let j = 0; j < element.options.length; j++) {
                                                    const item = element.options[j];
                                                    let option=document.createElement("option")
                                                    option.value=item
                                                    option.selected=false
                                                    option.textContent=item
                                                    select.append(option)
                                                }
                                                div.append(select)
                                                form.append(div)
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    setTimeout(() => {
                                        $('.itemcc-surveys-box').append(form)
                                    }, 500);
                                }
                               html += '</div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);
                    }
                    surveyViewModal.modal('show');
                    window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                    // 标记弹窗时间
                    localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
                }else{
                    // 无调查问卷返回时如果是取消订阅也应该支持提示
                    canceledSubscriptionModal();
                }
            },
            error: function (data) {
               // 无调查问卷返回时如果是取消订阅也应该支持提示
               canceledSubscriptionModal();
            }
        });
    }
    //选择inputs
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".custom-control-label", function () {
        $(this).parent().find(".custom-control-input").click();
    });
    // 选中其它
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", "input.categoryTypesCheck", function () {
        $(".survey-view-modal").find("#category001").prop("checked", false);
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", "#category001", function () {
        $(".survey-view-modal").find("input.categoryTypesCheck").prop("checked", false);
        return;
    })
        // 确定、清除
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".add-category", function (event) {
        event.stopPropagation()
        clearAddSellerNation($(this), 'add');
    return;

    });
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".clear-category", function () {
        clearAddSellerNation($(this), 'clear');
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".category-custorm-css", function (event) {
        event.stopPropagation()
        $(this).addClass('active')
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", function () {
        $('.category-custorm-css').removeClass('active')
        return;
    })
    function clearAddSellerNation($this, type) {
            let value = null;
            let dimensionTypesCheckItem = $("#category-box-cotent").find('input.categoryTypesCheck').filter(':checked');
            if (type == "add") {
                  let itemArr = [];
                  if (dimensionTypesCheckItem.length > 0) {
                        dimensionTypesCheckItem.each(function (i, el) {
                              itemArr.push($(el).val());
                        });
                        value = itemArr.length > 0 ? itemArr.join(',') : null;
                  }
                  if (dimensionTypesCheckItem.length > 0) {
                        $('#categorys').val(value);
                        $('.lable-category').text(value);
                  } else {
                        $('#categorys').val(null);
                        $('.lable-category').text($("#categorys").attr('placeholder'));
                  }
                $('.category-custorm-css').removeClass('active')
            } else if (type == "clear") {
                  value = null;
                  $('#categorys').val(value);
                  $('.lable-category').text($("#categorys").attr('placeholder'));
                  $("#category-box-cotent").find('input.categoryTypesCheck').prop("checked", false);
            }
      }
    $("#submitSurvey").bind('click', function () {
        if (sType == "P") {
            let data_arr = [];
            let check_arr = $('#pcheckbox input[type=checkbox]:checked');
            $.each(check_arr, function () {
                data_arr.push(
                    $(this).val()
                );
            });
            $("#answer").val(data_arr);
        }

        var answer = $("#answer").val();
        if (!answer) {
            alert("您还没有作答哦~");
            return;
        }
        if (answer == 'O') {
            answer = answer + '+' + $("#otherReason").val();
        }
        if(answer=="Q"){
            let form={}
            let validate=true
            $('#input_otherReason_OO :input[required]').each(function(){
                if ($(this).val() === '') {
                validate=false
                alert('请输入必选项')
                return false; 
            }
            if(!validate){
                return
            }
            })
            $('#input_otherReason_OO select[required]').each(function(){
                if ($(this).val() === '') {
                validate=false
                alert('请选择必选项')
                return false; 
            }
            })
            if(!validate){
                return
            }
            let arr=$("#input_otherReason_OO").serializeArray()   
            for (let index = 0; index < arr.length; index++) {
                const element = arr[index];
                form[element.name]=element.value
            }
            answer=answer+"+"+JSON.stringify(form)
        }
        $.ajax({
            type: "post",
            url: "/v2/survey/submitAnswer",
            data: {"id": $("#surveyId").val(), "answer": answer, "surveyType": sType},
            cache: false,
            async: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (data) {
                $('#surveyViewModal').modal('hide');
                // 标记弹窗时间
                localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
                if(url){
                    if (surveyCodeIn != "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL"){
                        swal({
                        title: '提交成功',
                        html: '<div>这次问卷的调查结果随后会发布到“<a class="community-link" href="'+url+'">精灵社区</a>”，</div>想第一时间知道调查结果，就立刻【加入关注】吧~',
                        imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-successful.png',
                        imageSize:'70x70',
                        showConfirmButton: true,
                        showCancelButton: true,
                        confirmButtonText: "加入关注",
                        cancelButtonText: "取消",
                        }).then(function(res){
                            if(res.value){
                            $.ajax({
                            type:"put",
                            url: '/bbs/follow-q/'+url.split('/')[url.split('/').length-1],
                            dataType: 'json',
                            contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                            data: JSON.stringify({}),
                            success: function (result) {
                            if(result && result.code == "OK") {
                            }else{
                            createYgtoastError(result.message || '网络错误，请稍后重试！',6000);
                                }
                            },
                            error: function (error) {
                                createYgtoastError(error.message || '网络错误，请稍后重试！',6000);
                             }
                             })
                            }
                        })
                    }
                }else{
                    if (surveyCodeIn != "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL") {
                        swal({
                            title: '提交成功',
                            html: '<div>非常非常感谢！我们会基于您的反馈不断改进产品<div>期待您的下次配合',
                            imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-successful.png',
                            imageSize:'70x70',
                            showConfirmButton: true
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    });

    $("#surveyContent").on("input propertychange", "#inputAnswer", function () {
        $("#answer").val($(this).val());
    });

    $("#surveyContent").on("click", 'input:radio[name="answerItem"]', function () {
        $("#answer").val($(this).val());
        if($(this).val()=="O"){
            $('.input_otherReason').show()
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').hide()
        }else if($(this).val()=="Q"){
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').show()
            $('.input_otherReason').hide()
        }else{
            $('.input_otherReason').hide()
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').hide()
        }
    });
    surveyViewModal.on("click", ".close", function () {
        surveyViewModal.modal('hide');
        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/survey/close-survey',
            data: {
                id: $("#surveyId").val()
            },
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function (obj) {

            },
            error: function () {}
        });
    });
    surveyViewModal.on('hide.bs.modal', function (event) {
        // 标记弹窗时间
        localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
        canceledSubscriptionModal();
    });
    // 无论有无调查问卷都要去继续流程
    function canceledSubscriptionModal(){
        if (surveyCodeIn == "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL") {
            swal({
                title: '取消订阅成功！',
                text: '非常非常感谢！您对卖家精灵的信任与支持，期待与您的下次合作',
                type: 'success',
                showConfirmButton: true
            }).then(function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    window.location.reload()
                }
            });
        }
    }


</script>

<script src="/assets-v2/js/jquery.cookie.js"></script>
<script>
    $(function () {
        var moduleMap = new Map([
            ["/v2/keyword-miner", "keyword-miner"],
            ["/v2/keyword-miner/dynamic", "keyword-miner"],
            ["/v2/keyword-research", "keyword-research"],
            ["/v2/keyword-research-weekly","keyword-research-weekly"],
            ["/v2/keyword-reverse", "keyword-reverse"],
            ["/v2/keyword-checker", "keyword-checker"],
            ["/v2/competitor-lookup", "competitor-lookup"],
            ["/v2/competitor-lookup/monthly", "competitor-lookup"],
            ["/v2/live-search", "live-search"],
            ["/v2/market-research", "market-research"],
            ["/v2/product-research", "product-research"],
        ])

        var selectors = [
            '#form-condition-search .dropdown-item',
            '#form-condition-keyword-earch .dropdown-item',
            '#form-condition-search button[data-market]',
            '#form-condition-search a[data-market-id]',
            '#form-condition-search button[data-market-id]',
           // '#form-condition-search select[name=monthName]',
            '#form-condition-search button[type=submit]',
            '#form-condition-search .monthName-button'
        ]

        $(selectors.join(",")).on('click', function () {
           
            var uri = `/v2/market-research`;            
            if (moduleMap.has(uri)) {
                $.cookie("module-station-" + moduleMap.get(uri), $(this).attr('data-market') || $(this).attr('data-market-id'), {
                    path: moduleMap.get(uri) === 'keyword-miner' ? '/v2/keyword-miner' : uri,
                    expires: 365,
                });
                if (uri === '/v2/competitor-lookup' || uri === '/v2/product-research' || uri === '/v2/competitor-lookup/monthly' || uri === '/v2/market-research'){
                    $.cookie("module-table-" + moduleMap.get(uri),
                        $('#form-condition-search').find('select[name=monthName] option:selected').val() || $(this).attr('data-month-id'), {
                        path: uri,
                        expires: 365
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    })

</script>

        justify-content: flex-start;
        padding: 0 5px;
    }

        display: block;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 400;
    }

        flex-grow: 3;
    }

    .pop-tooltip i {
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }
</style>

<script>
    //-------------------公共常量------------------------
    var showFormat = 'YYYY-MM-DD';
    $(document).ready(function () {
        //----------------弹窗 显示----------------------
        let $myPlaceSeller = $("#my-place-seller"), $body = $("body");

        $body.on('click', '.item-pop-piechart', function () {
            //展示弹窗
            $myPlaceSeller.modal();
            let datas = JSON.parse($(this).attr("data-itemdata"));
            let legend = [], itemData = [],unknown=-1;
            $(".modal-custom-pop h4").html($(this).attr("pop-type"));
            datas.forEach(function (e,index) {
                if(e.code=='UNKNOWN'){
                    unknown = index;
                }
                let itemname = e.nation, item = {
                    value: (e.ratio*1).toFixed(1),
                    name: itemname
                };
                legend.push(itemname);
                itemData.push(item)
            })
            chartsPie(legend, itemData,unknown);
            return false;
        });
        $myPlaceSeller.on('click', '.u-modal-window__close', function () {
            //展示弹窗
            $myPlaceSeller.modal('hide');
            return false;
        });
        function chartsPie(legend, itemData,unknown) {
            let $mySellerPie = "my-seller-pie", SellerPieTrendChart,colors = ['#FFAE2D', '#FF8B58', '#91CA80'];
            let chartsDom = document.getElementById($mySellerPie);
            chartsDom.removeAttribute("_echarts_instance_");
            Customer.showChartLoading(SellerPieTrendChart, $mySellerPie);
            SellerPieTrendChart = echarts.init(document.getElementById($mySellerPie), 'light');
            if(unknown<colors.length&&unknown>=0){
                colors.splice(unknown,0,'#D4D8E0')
              }else{
                colors.push('#D4D8E0')
              }
            option = {
                tooltip: {
                    trigger: 'item',
                    formatter: function (params) {
                        resp = '<div class="pop-tooltip"><i style="background-color:' + params.color + '"></i><span class="ml-2 mr-2">' + params.name + '</span><span>' + params.value + '%</span></div>';
                        return resp;
                    },
                },
                legend: {
                    orient: 'vertical',
                    x: '62%',
                    y: 'center',
                    itemWidth: 24,   // 设置图例图形的宽
                    itemHeight: 18,  // 设置图例图形的高
                    formatter: function (name) {
                        let data = itemData;
                        let tarValue = 0;
                        for (let i = 0, l = data.length; i < l; i++) {
                            if (data[i].name == name) {
                                tarValue = data[i].value;
                            }
                        }
                        let demohtml = ['{b|'+(name.length>6?(name.substring(0,7)+'...'):name)+'}','{em|'+tarValue+'%}'];
                        return demohtml.join('');
                    },
                    data: legend,
                    itemGap: 16,
                    itemWidth: 20,
                    itemHeight: 12,
                    textStyle: {
                        rich: {
                            b: {
                                fontSize: 12,
                                color: '#707376',
                                align: 'left',
                                lineHeight: 14,
                                textVerticalAlign: 'bottom',
                                padding: [0, 0, 3, 3],
                                display: 'block',
                                overflow: 'hidden',
                                width: 103,
                                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',

                            },
                            em: {
                                fontSize: 12,
                                color: '#707376',
                                align: 'right',
                                padding: [0, 0, 3, 3],
                                width:35,
                                display: 'inline-block',
                            }
                        }
                    },
                },
                //给每个饼图模块添加颜色
                color: colors,
                series: [ //添加一个模型
                    {
                        name: '卖家所属地分布',
                        type: 'pie', //模型的类型（饼图，柱状图等）
                        clockwise: true,//饼图是否顺时针排列
                        radius: ['30%', '70%'],
                        center: ['30%', '50%'],
                        data: itemData,
                        avoidLabelOverlap: false,
                        label: {
                            normal: {
                                show: false,
                                position: 'center'
                            },

                        },
                        labelLine: {
                            normal: {
                                show: false
                            }
                        },
                    },

                ]
            };
            // 使用刚指定的配置项和数据显示图表。
            SellerPieTrendChart.setOption(option);
            //关闭加载中
            Customer.closeChartLoading(SellerPieTrendChart);
        }

    });
    //-------------------弹窗事件---------------------------

</script>

        <td class="align-middle text-center">
            <div class="td align-items-center justify-content-center pt-2 pb-2">
                <select name="" class="tag-manage-select tag-manage-input-select">
                    {{each(ichild,item) tags}}
                    <option value="{{= item.label}}">{{= item.label}}</option>
                    {{/each}}
                </select>
            </div>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center pr-2">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center pt-2 pb-2 btn-tag-manage">
               <button data-toggle="tooltip" title="将原标签下市场全部合并到已有标签，并且删除原标签" data-type="concat-merge" class="btn btn-sm btn btn-success cursor-pointer-item">合并</button>
               <button data-toggle="tooltip" title="将包含该标签的市场，里面的该标签替换为新名称" data-type="save-tag" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary mr-2 ml-2 cursor-pointer-item">修改名称</button>
               <button data-toggle="tooltip" title="将包含该标签的市场，里面的该标签清除掉" data-type="delete-tag" class="btn btn-sm btn btn-gray-bg cursor-pointer-item color-white">删除</button>
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
    {{/each}}
    {{/if}}
</script>


<!-- //  data-collection-tags="data-tags-" -->
<script>
    $(function () {
        var Fn = {
            node: {
                $body: $("body"),
                $dom: $("#market-tag-management"),
                $collectionTag: $("#collection-tag-modal"),
                $managementBody: $("#tag-management-body"),
                $tagsHeadBody: $("#tags-head-body"),
                $collectionChangeTag: $("#collection-change-tag-modal"),
                collectionChangeData:null,
                $addCollectionTagModal: $("#add-collection-tag-modal"), //再次新增标签弹出框
                marketId: 1
            },
            init: function () {
                let that = this;
                that.node.$body.on("click", ".show-tips-manage", function () {
                    Fn.showTagManagePop($(this));
                });
                that.node.$dom.on("click", ".btn-tag-manage .btn", function () {
                    let type = $(this).attr("data-type"),$this = $(this);
                    $(this).tooltip('hide').parent(".btn-tag-manage").find(".btn").attr("disabled",true);
                    if(type =="concat-merge"){
                        Fn.cancotSaveTag($this,'concat-merge')
                    }else if(type =="save-tag"){
                        Fn.cancotSaveTag($this)
                    }else if(type =="delete-tag"){
                        Fn.deleteTag($this)
                    }
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$dom.on('click', '.u-modal-window__close', function () {
                    Fn.hideTagManagePop();
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$collectionTag.on('click','.u-modal-window__close',function () {
                    Fn.hideCollectionTagPop();
                    return false;
                })
                that.node.$collectionChangeTag.on('click','.u-modal-window__close',function () {
                    that.node.$collectionChangeTag.modal("hide");
                    return false;
                })
                that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.on('click','.u-modal-window__close',function () {
                    that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.modal("hide");
                    return false;
                })
                // 修改收藏标签
                that.node.$body.on("click",".curp-tags-change",function(){
                    // 修改标签
                    that.node.collectionChangeData = null;
                    let marketId = $(this).attr('data-marketId');
                    let nodeIdPath = $(this).attr('data-nodeIdPath');
                    let clientId = $(this).attr('data-clientId');
                    let title = $(this).attr('data-title');
                    let tags = $(this).parents(".text-secondary").find(".curp-tags-change");
                    let tagArry =[];
                    $.each(tags,function(index,item){
                        let tag  = $(item).attr("data-tags");
                        tag?tagArry.push(tag):null;
                    })
                    that.node.collectionChangeData = {
                        marketId:marketId,
                        nodeIdPath:nodeIdPath,
                        clientId:clientId,
                        title:title,
                        tags:tagArry,
                        domtags:$(this).parents(".text-secondary").attr("data-collection-tags")
                    }
                    that.node.$collectionChangeTag.modal('show');
                })
                that.node.$collectionChangeTag.on("change","[name=changeTags]",function(){
                    that.collectionChangeTagFc();
                })
                // 标签定义
                that.node.$collectionTag.on('hide.bs.modal',function () {
                    that.node.$collectionTag.find('[name=addTags]').val('');
                    that.node.$collectionTag.find('.collection-content-box').addClass('hide-addTags');
                })
                  // 标签定义
                that.node.$collectionChangeTag.on('hide.bs.modal',function () {
                    // 刷新页面
                    let dom = that.node.collectionChangeData.domtags;
                    that.node.$body.find("."+dom).find(".curp-tags-change").remove();
                    that.node.$body.find("."+dom).append($("#tpl-tags-collection").tmpl({ tags: that.node.$collectionChangeTag.tags,vo:that.node.collectionChangeData}));
                    $('[data-toggle=tooltip]').tooltip();
                })
                that.node.$collectionTag.on("click",'button.col-label',function () {
                    let $this = $(this);
                    let dataNum = $this.attr("data-number"),label = $this.attr("data-label");
                    dataNum = $this.is(".active")? dataNum*1-1 : dataNum*1+1;
                    if(dataNum == 0){
                        $this.remove();
                    }else{
                        $this.find("div>span").html(label +'('+ dataNum + ')').end().toggleClass("active").attr("data-number",dataNum);
                    }
                    that.addCollectionTagFc(false); 
                    return
                });
                // 展示添加更多标签
                that.node.$collectionTag.on("click",'.show-addtags-btn',function () {
                    that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.modal();
                    that.node.$collectionTag.css("z-index","999");
                    that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.find("button").attr("disabled",false)
                    that.fTagsSearchListener(false,that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.find('[name=addTags]'))
                    return
                });
                that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.on('hide.bs.modal',function () {
                    that.node.$collectionTag.css("z-index","1050");
                })
                that.node.$collectionTag.on('show.bs.modal',function () {
                    that.changeLoadTagList('add');
                })
                // 修改标签
                that.node.$collectionChangeTag.on('show.bs.modal',function () {
                    that.changeLoadTagList();
                    that.node.$collectionChangeTag.find(".title-market-segment").html(that.node.collectionChangeData.title);
                })
                // 保存标签
                that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.on("click",".save-tag-add",function(){
                    $(this).attr("disabled",true);
                    let tagArry = that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.find("[name=addTags]").val()||[];
                    that.node.$addCollectionTagModal.modal("hide");
                    that.addCollectionTagFc(tagArry);  
                });
            },
        
            //收藏页面修改标签
            changeLoadTagList:function(type){
                let that = this;
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'get',
                    url: '/v2/market-research/tag-manage/tags',
                    data: {marketId: that.node.marketId},
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success: function (result) {
                        let tags = [];
                        if (result.code == "OK") {
                            tags = result.data;
                            $.each(tags,function(index,item){
                                item.id = item.label
                                item.text = item.label
                            })
                        }
                        if(type == 'add'){
                            Fn.node.$tagsHeadBody.html($("#tpl-tags-head").tmpl({tags: tags}));
                        }else{
                            that.fTagsSearchListener(tags,that.node.$collectionChangeTag.find('[name=changeTags]'))
                        }
                    },
                    error: function () {
                        if(type == 'add'){
                            Fn.node.$tagsHeadBody.html($("#tpl-tags-head").tmpl({tags: []}));
                        }else{
                            that.fTagsSearchListener([],that.node.$collectionChangeTag.find('[name=changeTags]'))
                        }
                    }
                });
            },
            // 加载标签
            loadTagList: function () {
                let that = this;
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'get',
                    url: '/v2/market-research/tag-manage/tags',
                    data: {marketId: that.node.marketId},
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success: function (result) {
                        let tags = [];
                        if (result.code == "OK") {
                            tags = result.data;
                        }
                        Fn.node.$managementBody.html($("#tpl-management-body").tmpl({ tags: tags }));
                        Fn.node.$managementBody.find("button[data-toggle]").tooltip('show').tooltip('hide');
                    },
                    error: function () {
                        Fn.node.$managementBody.html($("#tpl-management-body").tmpl({ tags: [] }));
                    }
                });
            },
            //处理数据
            disposeDepartment: function (result,$this) {
                let tags = [];
                if (result.code&&result.code == "OK") {
                    Fn.createYgtoast("操作成功！",1500)
                    tags = result.data;
                    Fn.node.$managementBody.html($("#tpl-management-body").tmpl({ tags: tags }));
                    Fn.node.$managementBody.find("button[data-toggle]").tooltip('show').tooltip('hide');
                } else {
                    $this.parent(".btn-tag-manage").find(".btn").attr("disabled",false);
                    result.message?Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: result.message}):"";
                }

            },
            cancotSaveTag: function($this,type){
                let that = this;
                let $partentTr = $this.parents("tr");
                let label = type=='concat-merge'?$.trim($partentTr.find(".tag-manage-input").val()):$partentTr.find(".tag-manage-input").attr("data-old"),
                mergeLabel =type=='concat-merge'? $partentTr.find(".tag-manage-select option:selected").val():$.trim($partentTr.find(".tag-manage-input").val());
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'post',
                    url: '/v2/market-research/tag-manage/merge',
                    data: { marketId: that.node.marketId, tag: label, newTag: mergeLabel},
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success: function (result) {
                        Fn.disposeDepartment(result,$this);
                    },
                    error: function (e) {
                        Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e.message})
                    }
                });
            },
            deleteTag: function($this){
                let that = this;
                let $partentTr = $this.parents("tr");
                let label = $.trim($partentTr.find(".tag-manage-input").val());
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'post',
                    url: '/v2/market-research/tag-manage/delete',
                    data: { marketId: that.node.marketId, tag: label},
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success: function (result) {
                        Fn.disposeDepartment(result,$this);
                    },
                    error: function (e) {
                        Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e.message})
                    }
                });
            },
            // 给tag添加value
             fTagsSearchListener:function(_allTags,$e) {
                let that = this;
                $e.val('');
                $e.select2({
                    data: _allTags||[],
                    tags: true,
                    width: '100%',
                    language: "zh-CN",
                    multiple: true,
                    placeholder:'输入新标签'
                });
                if(that.node.collectionChangeData&&that.node.collectionChangeData.tags){
                    $e.val(that.node.collectionChangeData.tags).trigger('change');
                } 
            },
            // 修改tag
            collectionChangeTagFc:function(){
                let that = this;
                if(!that.node.collectionChangeData){return}
                var url = '/v2/market-research/updateCollect/' + that.node.collectionChangeData.clientId + '/' + that.node.collectionChangeData.marketId + '/' + that.node.collectionChangeData.nodeIdPath;
                    var tag =null;
                    let tagArry = that.node.$collectionChangeTag.find("[name=changeTags]").val()||[];
                        tag = tagArry.join(",");
                        url += "?tags=" + tag;  
                        that.node.$collectionChangeTag.tags = tagArry;
                   // 新增标签
                    $.ajax({
                        type: 'get',
                        url: url,
                        contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                        dataType: 'json',
                        success: function (result) {
                            // that.changeLoadTagList(); 
                        },
                        error: function () {
                        }
                    });
            },
            // 新增标签
            addCollectionTagFc:function(_tagArry){
                let that = this;
                let marketId = that.node.$collectionTag.attr('data-marketId');
                let nodeIdPath = that.node.$collectionTag.attr('data-nodeIdPath');
                let clientId = that.node.$collectionTag.attr('data-clientId');
                let url = '/v2/market-research/updateCollect/' + clientId + '/' + marketId + '/' + nodeIdPath;
                let tag = null;
                let tagArry = [];
                $.extend(true, tagArry, _tagArry)
                let activeBtn = that.node.$collectionTag.find("button.col-label.active");
                $.each(activeBtn,function(index,item){
                   let lable = $(item).attr("data-label");
                   tagArry.push(lable);
                })
                let newTagArry = Array.from(new Set(tagArry))
                if(newTagArry.length>0){
                    tag = newTagArry.join(",");
                    url += "?tags=" + tag;
                }
                // 新增
                if(_tagArry){
                    let _NewtagsArry = [];
                    $.each(_tagArry,function(index,item){
                        let btnlabel = $("button.col-label[data-label = "+item+"]");
                        if(btnlabel.length>0){
                            let numLabel = 1;
                             if(btnlabel.is(".active")){
                                numLabel = 1;
                             }else{
                                numLabel = btnlabel.attr("data-number")*1+1;
                                btnlabel.addClass("active");
                             }
                             btnlabel.attr("data-number",numLabel).find("div>span").html(item +'('+ numLabel + ')');
                        }else{
                            let label= {
                                label:item,
                                number: 1,
                                checked: true,
                            }
                            _NewtagsArry.push(label)
                        }
                         
                    });
                    _NewtagsArry.length>0?Fn.node.$tagsHeadBody.find(".show-addtags-btn").remove().end().append($("#tpl-tags-head").tmpl({tags: _NewtagsArry})):null;
                }
                // 新增标签
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'get',
                    url: url,
                    contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success: function (result) {
                        if (result.code === 'OK') {
                            
                        } else {
                            swal({
                                title: '收藏失败',
                                text: result.message,
                                type: 'error'
                            });
                            // that.changeLoadTagList('add');
                        }
                    },
                    error: function () {
                        // that.changeLoadTagList('add');
                        swal({
                            title: '收藏失败',
                            text: '收藏失败，请稍后重试！',
                            type: 'error'
                        });
                    }
                });
            },
            showInputsTips: function (message) {
                $("tr.new-add-list .icon-label-compile").attr('title', '').attr('data-original-title', message).tooltip('show');
                setTimeout(function () {
                    $("tr.new-add-list .icon-label-compile").attr('data-original-title', '').tooltip('hide');
                }, 2000);
            },
            
            showTagManagePop: function ($this) {
                $('#sidebar-tags button.close').click();
                Fn.loadTagList();
                Fn.hideCollectionTagPop();
                Fn.node.$dom.modal();
            },
            showTipPop: function (params) {
                swal({
                    title: params.title ? params.title : '温馨提示',
                    text: params.text?params.text:'主人，请求太过频繁，网络不稳定，请稍后重试！',
                    imageUrl: params.imageUrl ? params.imageUrl : '../../../assets/images/bounced-warning.png',
                    imageSize: '70x70',
                    showConfirmButton: true,
                });
            },
            hideTagManagePop: function () {
                Fn.node.$dom.modal('hide');
            },
            showCollectionTagPop:function(){
              Fn.node.$collectionTag.modal();
            },
            hideCollectionTagPop: function () {
                Fn.node.$collectionTag.modal('hide');
            },
            createYgtoast: function(str,duration) {
				let toastHtml = '<div  class="toast-content-box" style="top: 74px;right: 42%"><div class="toast toast-success" aria-live="polite"><div class="toast-message"></div></div></div>';
				document.querySelector(".toast-content-box")?'':Fn.node.$body.append(toastHtml);    //当还没hide时禁止重复点击
                $(".toast-content-box").fadeIn().find(".toast-message").html('<i class="iconfont icon-have-authorized mr-2"></i>'+str);
                setTimeout(function(){
                    $(".toast-content-box").fadeOut();
                },duration)
			},
        }
        Fn.init();
    });

</script>

<script id="tpl-research-choose-body" type="text/template">
  {{if customListList.length==0}}
    <tr class="nodata-tr">
      <td class="text-center" colspan="5">
          <div class="item-no-data d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">主人~ 暂无自定义选品模式！<br/> 建议您点击“保存当前模式”按钮保存您的专属模式<br/> 保存后，下次可点击您的专属模式一键查询</div>
      </td>
    </tr>
    {{else}} 
    {{each(i,vo) customListList}}
    {{if vo.id=="newAdd"}}
    <tr class="new-add-list"  data-trid="{{= vo.id}}">
    {{else}}
    <tr data-trid="{{= vo.id}}" class="category-list-tr">
    {{/if}}
      <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center pl-2">
                  {{= vo.id=='newAdd'? i : (i+1)}}
            </div>
      </td>
      <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center pl-1">
                  <span class="${ModuleCustomPreset.marketChoice(vo.content)}"></span>
            </div>
      </td>
        <td class="text-left align-middle">
           <div class="td d-flex align-items-center pl-1">
               <input type="text" value="{{= vo.descibe}}" class="form-control form-control-sm caname-item-choose {{= vo.id == 'newAdd'?'':'is-show-choose'}}" placeholder="输入新模式名称" data-oldtext='{{= vo.descibe}}' ${ (vo.id =='newAdd')?'':'disabled'}>
           </div>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center">
                ${moment(vo.createdTime).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}
            </div>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center pr-2">
            <div class="td align-items-center justify-content-center choosemode-save {{= vo.id == 'newAdd'?'d-flex':''}}">
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary btn-choosemode-save pt-1 pb-1 pl-2 pr-2 cursor-pointer-item">保存</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary btn-choosemode-delete pt-1 pb-1 pl-2 pr-2 cursor-pointer-item">删除</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-secondary pt-1 pb-1 pl-2 pr-2 cursor-pointer-item ml-2 btn-cancal-choose">取消</button>
            </div>
            <div class="td align-items-center justify-content-center choosemode-edite {{= vo.id!='newAdd'?'d-flex':''}}">
                  <a class="link-muted no-decoration lighter comment-operation"href="javascrtip:;" data-toggle="tooltip" title="编辑"><i class="iconfont icon-comment1 font-size-14"></i></a>
                  <a class="link-muted no-decoration lighter ml-2 delete-operation" href="javascrtip:;" data-toggle="tooltip" title="删除"><i class="iconfont icon-delete"></i></a>
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary pt-1 pb-1 pl-2 pr-2 cursor-pointer-item ml-3 quick-accessto" >快速访问</button>
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
    {{/each}}
    {{/if}}
</script><script src="/assets-v2/customer/customer.js?v202608281130"></script>

<div class="modal fade" id="modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="myModalLabel">
    <div class="modal-dialog modal-lg" role="document">
        <div class="modal-content" style="min-width: 65rem;">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <div class="h4 modal-title" style="position: relative;z-index: 999;">类目选择<span style="color: #fb8c1e;font-size:14px;" class="fal fa-question-circle ml-1 mr-2"  data-tips='<p>鼠标移至类目可查看该类目的全部路径</p><p>类目后数字代表该类目下收录的ASIN数量<br>类目来自于商品上架类目，也就是Listing左上角的类目，详细解释请&nbsp;<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/product-category-of-sellersprite&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;>点击这里</a></p><p><br></p><p>由于产品数据与类目收录的ASIN数据更新时间不统一，可能会导致类目下的ASIN收录数与查询结果数不一致</p>' ></span><small class="red">(单击选中，双击进入下级类目)</small><br/></div>
                <div style="margin-left: 8.21rem" class="h4 modal-title">
                    类目查询<span style="color: #fb8c1e;font-size:14px;" class="fal fa-question-circle ml-1"  data-tips='<p>类目查询方法请戳<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/select-category-guide&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>《类目查询技巧全揭秘》</a></p>' ></span>
                </div>
                <button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"><span aria-hidden="true">&times;</span></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
                <form class="form-horizontal" role="form" action="#" method="POST">
                    <style>
                        .scroll-hidden {
                            overflow-x: scroll;
                        }
                        .scroll-hidden::-webkit-scrollbar {
                            display: none;
                        }
                        ul.children-nodes {
                            margin-left: -1rem;
                            margin-right: -0.4rem;
                            margin-top: -0.72rem;
                        }
                        ul.children-nodes li {
                            border-bottom: 1px dashed #E5E5E5;
                            padding: 0.4rem 1.1rem;
                            color: #767676;
                            margin-top: 0;
                            margin-bottom: 0;
                            align-items: center;
                        }
                        ul.children-nodes li:last-child {
                            border-bottom: 0 dashed #d5d5d5;
                        }
                        ul.children-nodes li:hover {
                            background-color: #f9f9f9;
                            cursor: pointer;
                        }
                        ul.children-nodes li.active {
                            background-color: #FB8C1E !important;
                            cursor: pointer;
                            color: #fff;
                        }
                        ul.children-nodes li .text-desc-word{
                            display: block;
                            flex: 1;
                            line-height: 1.2rem;
                        }
                        ul.children-nodes li:hover .text-desc-word{
                            text-decoration: underline;
                            text-decoration-style:dashed;
                            color: #FB8C1E;
                        }
                        ul.children-nodes li.active:hover .text-desc-word{
                            color: #fff;
                        }
                    </style>

                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="col-5 col-xs-5 scroll-hidden" style="border-right: 1px solid #d5d5d5;min-height: 33rem;padding: 5rem 0.4rem 0.4rem 1.1rem;margin-top: -5.3rem;margin-bottom: -1rem;">
                            <div class="text-center mt-5 fa-spin-box pt-4"><img src="/assets/images/admin-loading.gif" alt="" width="24" class="mt-4"></div>
                            <div class="h5 label-lg label-warning label-white" name="none-children-node" style="height: 60px;margin: 0px -1rem 0px -1rem; font-size: 12px;line-height: 20px;">
                                未检索到类目或类目已经是最后一级！<br>
                            </div>
                            <ul class="list-unstyled spaced children-nodes"></ul>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-7 col-xs-7" style="padding-right: 1.1rem;padding-left: 1.1rem;">
                            <div class="row mb-2">
                                <div class="col-9">
                                    <div class="form-group mb-md-0">
                                        <input id="node-nav-label"  data-suggestions ="show" type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm" name="nodeLabel" value="" placeholder="输入Node ID/类目关键词，如281407/Electronics" autocomplete="off">
                                    </div>
                                    <div id="suggestions-nodesList" class="suggestions-nodesList-box scroll-show-auto"></div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="col-2" >
                                    <button id="node-nav-label-btn" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-success"><i class="far fa-search"></i> 检索类目</button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <p>您选择了类目<small class="red" style="font-size: 100%;"> (点击下面类目可返回)</small></p>
                            <ul class="breadcrumbs-node vertical" style="min-height: 140px;"></ul>
                            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary pull-right" type="button" style="margin-top: 2.9rem;margin-left: 0.72rem;" name="nav-use-current-node"><i class="fal fa-check-square"></i> 选择类目</button>
                            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-indigo pull-right" type="button" style="margin-top: 2.9rem;color: #fff;" name="nav-clear-current-node"><i class="fal fa-trash-alt"></i> 清空类目</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="help-block col-xs-12 col-sm-reset inline"></div>
                </form>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div id="favorite-modal" class="js-modal-window u-modal-window" style="max-width: 580px;">
    <div class="card">
        <div class="p-4 text-center">
            <button type="button" class="close ml-n3" onclick="Custombox.modal.closeAll();">
                <span class="font-size-2">×</span>
            </button>
            <div class="h5 m-0"><strong>加入关注</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div id="favorite-modal-alert" class="alert-danger px-7 py-3 mt-4" style="display: none;">
            <strong class="text-secondary">错误提示</strong>
            <p class="text-muted m-0 mt-2"><small>添加到关注后，您可以随时找到并查看这些产品的排名、价格、销量等信息，我们会每日监控其库存变化。</small></p>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div id="container-attention" class="card"></div>
    <div class="card">
        <div class="alert-primary px-7 py-3 mt-4">
            <strong class="text-secondary">温馨提示</strong>
            <p class="text-muted m-0 mt-2"><small>添加到关注后，您可以随时找到并查看这些产品的排名、价格、销量等信息，我们会每日监控其库存变化。</small></p>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script id="tpl-container-attention" type="text/template">
    <ul class="list-unstyled m-0 d-flex flex-wrap px-7 mt-4">
        {{each(index,item) utags}}
            {{if product.tags && product.tags.indexOf(item.label)>=0 }}
                <li class="btn btn-sm btn-primary mr-3 mb-3 tag-label belong-to" data-id="{{= product.id}}" data-station="{{= product.station}}" data-asin="{{= product.asin}}" data-label="{{= item.label}}" >
                    {{if 'DEFAULT' == item.label}} 未分组 {{else}} {{= item.label}} {{/if}} ({{= item.number}})
                </li>
            {{else}}
                <li class="btn btn-sm btn-secondary mr-3 mb-3 tag-label" data-id="{{= product.id}}" data-station="{{= product.station}}" data-asin="{{= product.asin}}" data-label="{{= item.label}}" >
                    {{if 'DEFAULT' == item.label}} 未分组 {{else}} {{= item.label}} {{/if}} ({{= item.number}})
                </li>
            {{/if}}
        {{/each}}
    </ul>
    <div class="row no-gutters mt-4 px-7">
        <div class="col-9 col-md-10">
            <div class="input-group input-group-sm">
                <input id="modal-input-tag" name="tag" type="text" class="form-control" placeholder="新类目名称">
                <div class="input-group-append">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-action="createAddTag" data-id="{{= product.id}}" >添加到该类目</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-3 col-md-2 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-end">
            <a href="javascript:;" data-action="tag-manage">标签管理</a>
        </div>
    </div>
</script>


<script id="tpl-breadcrumb-node-item" type="text/template">
    <li><span class="a-list-item"><a data-node="#NODE_ID#" data-label="#NODE_LABEL_PATH#" data-html="true" data-toggle="tooltip" data-original-title="点击重选类目导航 #NODE_LABEL_BREAD_PATH#">#NODE_LABEL#</a>
        <button class="btn btn-danger btn-xs hidden" type="button" style="display: none;" name="nav-use-current-node" data-node="#NODE_ID#" data-label="#NODE_LABEL_PATH#">选择此类目</button>
    </span></li>
</script>

<script id="tpl-breadcrumb-node-divider" type="text/template">
    <li class="breadcrumb-divider"><span class="a-list-item a-color-tertiary">›</span></li>
</script>


<script id="id_tpl_script_global_tags_data" type="text/template">
    {{each(index,item) labelItems}}
    <tr>
        <td class="align-middle text-center">{{= index+1}}</td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center"><input class="form-control form-control-sm" type="text" style="min-width: 150px;" name="label" origin-label="{{= item.label}}" value="{{if 'DEFAULT' == item.label}}未分组{{else}}{{= item.label}}{{/if}}"></td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center">{{= item.number}}</td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center">
            <select class="form-control form-control-sm" name="mergeLabel" style="min-width: 150px;" >
                {{each(num,obj) labelItems}}
                <option value="{{= obj.label}}">{{if 'DEFAULT' == obj.label}}未分组{{else}}{{= obj.label}}{{/if}}</option>
                {{/each}}
            </select>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center">
            <button style="cursor: pointer;"  class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-warning" data-action="tagsMergeBtn"     data-html="true" data-toggle="tooltip" data-placement="top" data-original-title="将原标签下商品全部合并到已有标签，并且删除原标签 " >开始合并</button>
            <button style="cursor: pointer;"  class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-success ml-3" data-action="tagsModifyBtn"    data-html="true" data-toggle="tooltip" data-placement="top" data-original-title="将包含该标签的商品，里面的该标签替换为新名称">修改名称</button>
            <button style="cursor: pointer;"  class="btn btn-xs btn-outline-danger ml-3"  data-action="tagsDeleteBtn"    data-html="true" data-toggle="tooltip" data-placement="top" data-original-title="将包含该标签的商品，里面的该标签清除掉" >删除标签</button>
        </td>
    </tr>
    {{/each}}
</script>

<script id="nodeIdPath-radios-tpl" type="text/template">
    <div class="col-12 col-md-6">

        </div>
        {{each(index,item) items}}

                    <input name="bsrIds[{{= index+2}}]" value="{{= item.node_id_path}}" type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" id="categoryName-checkbox-0-{{= index}}">

                        <span class="chiness-laguage-nodes">{{= chinessList[item.node_id_path]}}</span>

    <div class="col-12 col-md-6">
        {{each(index,item) items}}

            <input name="bsrIds[{{= index+2}}]" value="{{= item.node_id_path}}" type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" id="categoryName-checkbox-1-{{= index}}">
            <input name="titles[{{= index+2}}]" value="{{= item.node_label_path}}" type="hidden" class="custom-control-input" id="categoryName-checkbox-1-{{= index}}">
            <label for="categoryName-checkbox-1-{{= index}}" class="custom-control-label">
                <span class="locale-laguage-nodes">{{= item.node_label_path}}</span>
                <span class="chiness-laguage-nodes">{{= chinessList[item.node_id_path]}}</span>
            </label>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{/each}}
    </div>
</script>

                if(marketId == station['code'] || marketId == station['marketId'] || marketId == ('' + station['marketId'])) return tableNodes;
