","appliances":"大型家电","fashion":"服装","office":"文具与办公用品","tools":"DIY工具","musical-instruments":"乐器","luggage":"行李箱包","hpc":"健康与个人护理","handmade":"手工制品","kitchen":"家居厨房用品","videogames":"电子游戏","jewelry":"珠宝","toys":"游戏和玩具","sports":"运动与户外用品","pet-supplies":"宠物用品","lighting":"照明","shoes":"鞋靴和包","industrial":"商业、工业和科学","pc":"计算机","books":"图书","watch":"手表","grocery":"食品及家居用品","baby":"婴儿用品","amazon-devices":"亚马逊设备及配件","boost":"亚马逊发明家计划","garden":"园艺","automotive":"汽车和摩托车用品"},"44571":{"electronics":"电子","beauty":"美妆","audible":"有声读物","apparel":"服装","office":"文具与办公用品","home-improvement":"DIY工具","musical-instruments":"乐器","luggage":"行李箱包","hpc":"健康与个人护理","kitchen":"家居厨房用品","videogames":"电子游戏","jewelry":"珠宝","toys":"游戏和玩具","sports":"运动与户外用品","pet-supplies":"宠物用品","shoes":"鞋靴和包","industrial":"商业、工业和科学","computers":"计算机","books":"图书","music":"音乐","dvd":"DVD","digital-text":"电子书","watches":"手表","grocery":"食品及家居用品","baby":"婴儿用品","boost":"亚马逊发明家计划","garden":"园艺","software":"软件","mobile-apps":"安卓APP","gift-cards":"礼品卡","automotive":"汽车和摩托车用品"}};
        // $container.html('');
        var tablesNodes = getTablesNodes(marketId);
        if(!tablesNodes) return false;
        var data = tablesNodes['nodes'];
        var items = data.items;
        //非美国站，取出top前30
        if('1' != marketId && data.items.length > 30){
            items.sort(function(a, b){
                return parseInt(b.products, 10) - parseInt(a.products, 10);
            });
            items = items.slice(0,30);
            items.sort(function(a,b){
                if(a['node_label_path'] > b['node_label_path']) return 1;
                if(a['node_label_path'] == b['node_label_path']) return 0;
                return -1;
            });
        }
        // $container.removeClass('is_active').addClass(showConditionChinese !='N'?"is_active":'');
        // $form.find('.category-chinese-box').prop('checked',(showConditionChinese !='N'? true : false));
        // showConditionChinese = conditionChineseStorage(false, 'condition_chinese_category'),
        $container.html($('#nodeIdPath-radios-tpl').tmpl({items:items,chinessList:chinessChoosingList[marketId]}));
        $('#nodeIdPath-radios-container [name^=bsrIds]').unbind().click(function () {
            var c = $(this).prop('checked');
            if($(this).parents().hasClass("any-all-checkbox")){
                $('#nodeIdPath-radios-container [name^=bsrIds]').prop('checked', false);
            }else{
                $('#nodeIdPath-radios-container .any-all-checkbox [name^=bsrIds]').prop('checked', false);
            }
            $(this).prop('checked', c);
            // $('ul.breadcrumbs-node').html('');
        });
        //如果存在类目
        var bsrIds = JSON.parse('' || '[]');
        var nodeIdPath = $form.find('input[name="nodeIdPath"]').val();
        $.each(bsrIds,function(index,value){  //arrTmp数组数据
            $container.find('[name^=bsrIds][value="' + value + '"]').click();
        });
    }
    // 页面加载完毕就渲染一次类目
    if($('#nodeIdPath-radios-container').length >0) fillNodeIdPathRadios();
   //切换中文显示类目
    function conditionChineseStorage(newbie_swicth, beginner_guide) {
          newbie_swicth = newbie_swicth ? newbie_swicth : false;
          if (window.localStorage) {
              let itemLen = window.localStorage.getItem(beginner_guide);
              if (!newbie_swicth) {
                  return itemLen;
              } else {
                  window.localStorage.setItem(beginner_guide, newbie_swicth);
              }
          }
          return false;
    }
    $(document).ready(function(){
        //类目导航
        $('#btn-nav-node-dialog').click(function () {
            $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog ul.breadcrumbs-node').html('')
            var n = $('#form-condition-search input[name=nodeIdPath]').val();
            fLoadNode(n);
            $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog').modal();
        });

        function fLoadNode(_node, fillRadios, byLabel) {
            var market = $('#form-condition-search input[name=marketId]').val();
            var pageType = $('#form-condition-search #page-type').val();
            var $holder = $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog .children-nodes'),
                $none = $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog [name=none-children-node]'),
                $spiner = $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog div.fa-spin-box'),
                $selected = $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog ul.breadcrumbs-node');
            var nodeLabel = $('#node-nav-label').val();

            var monthTable = $("#form-condition-search select[name='monthName']").val();
            var weekTable = $("#form-condition-search select[name='weekName']").val();
            var table = monthTable === undefined ? weekTable === undefined ? '' : weekTable : monthTable;

            $holder.empty();
            $selected.empty();//选择类目旁边的一选类目
            $spiner.show();
            $none.hide();

            var _url = '/v2/competitor-lookup/nodes?' + 'marketId=' + market + "&table=" + table;
            _node && _node != '' && (_url += '&nodeIdPath=' + _node);

            if(byLabel){
                if (nodeLabel) {
                    var arr = nodeLabel.split(":");
                    nodeLabel = arr[arr.length-1].trim();
                }
                var _url = '/v2/competitor-lookup/nodes?' + 'marketId=' + market + "&table=" + table;
                nodeLabel && nodeLabel != '' && (_url += '&nodeLabelPath=' + nodeLabel.replace(/&/g,"%26"));
            }

            $.getJSON(_url, function (data) {
                $spiner.hide();
                // 显示提示消息
                /*if (data.code != 'OK'){
                    swal({
                        text:data.code,
                        type:'success'
                    });
                }*/
                if (!data.items || !data.items.length) $none.show();

                // if(fillRadios) fillNodeIdPathRadios(data);

                for (var i = 0; data.items && data.items.length > 0 && i < data.items.length; i++) {
                    var _locale = "";
                    try {
                        var _localeTemp = data.items[i].nodeLabelLocale;
                        var arr = data.items[i]['label'].split(":");
                        if (_localeTemp && arr[arr.length - 1] !== _localeTemp) {
                            _locale = '(' + _localeTemp + ')';
                        }
                    }catch (e) {
                        console.error("parse locale error " + e)
                    }
                    var _i = data.items[i]['id'], _l = data.items[i]['label'] + _locale, _labels = _l.split(":"), _o = '',
                        _p = data.items[i]['products'] ? ('<span class="badge ml-2 d-block mt-0" title="商品数量(包含子类目)" style="height: 20px;line-height: 16px;">' + data.items[i]['products'].toLocaleString() + '<span>') : '';
                    _l.indexOf(':') && (_l = _labels[_labels.length - 1]);
                    !_l.indexOf(':') && (_o = '&nbsp;(' + _i + ')');

                    var label_show = '"'+data.items[i]['label'].replace(/:/g," › ")+'"'
                    $holder.append('<li class="d-flex" title='+label_show+' data-id="' + data.items[i]['id'] + '" data-label="' + _l + '" data-label-path="' + data.items[i]['label'] +'"><span class="text-desc-word">'
                        + (data.items[i]['alias'] || _l) + _o + '&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>' + _p + '</li>');
                }
                if (data.parent && data.parent.id && data.parent.label && data.parent.id.split(":").length == data.parent.label.split(":").length) {
                    var ids = data.parent.id.split(":"), labels = data.parent.label.split(":"), _id = '', _label = '';
                    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
                        i > 0 && (_id += ':');
                        i > 0 && (_label += ':');
                        _id += ids[i];
                        var parentLocale = "";
                        try {
                            var localeLabels = data.parent.nodeLabelPathLocale.split(":")
                            var l = localeLabels[i];
                            if (l && labels[i] !== l) {
                                parentLocale = '(' + l + ')';
                            }
                        }catch (e) {
                            console.error("parse locale error")
                        }
                        _label += labels[i];

                        var item = $('#tpl-breadcrumb-node-item').html().replace(/#NODE_ID#/g, _id).replace(/#NODE_LABEL#/g, labels[i] + parentLocale)
                            .replace(/#NODE_LABEL_PATH#/g, _label).replace(/#NODE_LABEL_BREAD_PATH#/g, _label.replace(/:/g, ' › '));
                        $selected.append(item);
                    }
                    fListenBreadAClick($selected);
                }

                fListenButtonClick();
            });
        }

        function fListenButtonClick() {
            var $selected = $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog ul.breadcrumbs-node'),
                $use = $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog button[name=nav-use-current-node]'),
                $query = $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog button[name=nav-query-children-node]');
            $query.prop('disabled', true);

            $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog .children-nodes li').unbind().click(function () {
                var cancel = $(this).hasClass('active'), _i = $(this).attr('data-id'), _l = $(this).attr('data-label'), _lp = $(this).attr('data-label-path'),
                    parent = _i.indexOf(':') < 0,
                    item = $('#tpl-breadcrumb-node-item').html().replace(/#NODE_ID#/g, _i).replace(/#NODE_LABEL#/g, _l)
                        .replace(/#NODE_LABEL_PATH#/g, _lp).replace(/#NODE_LABEL_BREAD_PATH#/g, _lp.replace(/:/g, ' › ')).replace('hidden', ''),
                    $last = $selected.find('li:last'), last_id = $last.find('a').attr('data-node');
                parent && ($selected.empty());
                !parent && _i && last_id && _i.split(':').length == last_id.split(':').length && ($last.remove());
                if (!cancel) {
                    $selected.append(item);
                    $selected.find('a[data-node]').tooltip();
                }
                $query.prop('disabled', cancel);

                $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog .children-nodes li').removeClass('active');
                !cancel && $(this).addClass('active');
                fListenBreadAClick($selected);
                fListendUseCurrentButton();

                return true;
            });
            $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog .children-nodes li').dblclick(function () {
                var _i = $(this).attr('data-id');
                fLoadNode(_i);

                return true;
            });

            $query.unbind().click(function () {
                if ($(this).attr('disabled')) return false;

                var _id = $selected.find('a[data-node]:last').attr('data-node');
                fLoadNode(_id);

                return true
            });

            function fListendUseCurrentButton() {
                $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog button[name=nav-use-current-node]').unbind().click(function () {
                    // 清空主类目
                    // $('#nodeIdPath-radios-container .custom-control-input').val('');
                    $('#nodeIdPath-radios-container .custom-control-input').prop('checked',false);
                    // $('#categoryName-checkbox-0').prop('checked',true);
                    $('#form-condition-search input[name=allChecked]').val(false)
                    var $node = $selected.find('a[data-node]:last');
                    $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog').modal('hide');
                    var id = $node.attr('data-node') || '', label = $node.attr('data-label') || '' ,
                        $bread = $('#form-condition-search ul.breadcrumbs-node');
                    $bread.empty();
                    $('#form-condition-search input[name=nodeIdPath]').val(id);
                    if(id){
                        $('.custom-checkbox input[name=filterSub]').removeAttr('disabled');
                    }
                    var ids = id.split(":"), labels = label.split(":"), _id = '', _label = '';
                    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
                        i > 0 && (_id += ':');
                        i > 0 && (_label += ':');
                        _id += ids[i];
                        _label += labels[i];

                        var item = $('#tpl-breadcrumb-node-item').html().replace(/#NODE_ID#/g, _id).replace(/#NODE_LABEL#/g, labels[i])
                            .replace(/#NODE_LABEL_PATH#/g, _label).replace(/#NODE_LABEL_BREAD_PATH#/g, _label.replace(/:/g, ' › '));
                        i > 0 && ($bread.append($('#tpl-breadcrumb-node-divider').html()));
                        $bread.append(item);
                    }

                    fListenSearchFormBreadAClick();

                    return true
                });
                $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog button[name=nav-clear-current-node]').unbind().click(function () {
                    //$('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog').modal('hide');
                    $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog .breadcrumbs-node li:first a').click();
                    $('#form-condition-search ul.breadcrumbs-node').empty();
                    $('ul.breadcrumbs-node').html('');
                    $('#form-condition-search input[name=nodeIdPath]').val('');
                    // if($('#form-condition-search #categoryName-checkbox-0').length > 0) $('#form-condition-search #categoryName-checkbox-0').click();
                    if($('#node-nav-label').length > 0) $('#node-nav-label').val('');

                    return true
                });
            }
            fListendUseCurrentButton();
        }

        // 搜索
        function debounce(func,delay){
            let timer;
            return function(){
                clearTimeout(timer)
                let $this = $(this);
                let showSuggestions = $this.attr("data-suggestions");
                if(!showSuggestions){return}
                timer = setTimeout(function(){
                    let $content = $this.parent().parent().find(".suggestions-nodesList-box");
                    let keywords = $this.val(),station = $('#form-condition-search input[name=marketId]').val();
                    let monthTable = $("#form-condition-search select[name='monthName']").val();
                    func($content,keywords,monthTable,station)
                },delay)
            }
        }
        function handle($content,keywords,monthTable,station){
            const searchInput = document.querySelector('#searchInput');
            if (searchInput && getCurrentType() !== 'mr') {
               return
            }
            monthTable = monthTable || 'bsr_sales_nearly';
            if($('#searchType').val()){
                station = stationMeta[$('#stationSelect').val()].marketId
                let date = $('#dateSelect').val()
                const now = new Date().getFullYear() + (new Date().getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
                monthTable = !date || date === now ? 'bsr_sales_nearly' : 'bsr_sales_monthly_' + date
            }
            //todo
            if (!keywords || keywords.length >=30) {
                $content.html('');
                $content.hide();
                return
            }
            $content.html('');
            $.ajax({
                type: "get",
                url: "/v2/competitor-lookup/nodesList",
                data: {marketId: station, table: monthTable, nodeLabelPath: keywords},
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (data) {
                    if (data && data.length > 0) {
                        let re = '';
                        $.each(data, function (index, value) {
                            // 展示的label
                            let newquery = value.label;
                            let flagnew = keywords;
                            if(flagnew!=null){
                                let newstr = newquery.replace(new RegExp(flagnew,"ig"), "<strong>$&</strong>");
                                let item = newstr.replace(newstr, "<span class='item'>"+newstr+"</span>");
                                let searches_div = "<span class='searches'>" + Customer.commafy(value.products,0) + "</span>";
                                re += '<a class="suggest-item" data-lable = "'+value.label+'" title="'+value.label+'"  href="javascript:;" >'+ item + searches_div+'</a>';
                            }
                        });
                        $content.html(re).show();
                    }else {
                        $content.html('').show();
                    }
                }
            });

        }
        //输入后延迟1秒搜索
        $('#node-nav-label,.departmentKeyword-inputs').on('keyup', debounce(handle,500));
        let blurClose = null;
        $('#node-nav-label,.departmentKeyword-inputs').on('blur', function(){
            clearTimeout(blurClose)
            let $this = $(this);
            blurClose = setTimeout(()=>{
                $this.parent().parent().find(".suggestions-nodesList-box").hide();
            },500)
        })
        $('#node-nav-label,.departmentKeyword-inputs').on('focus', function(){
            let $this = $(this);
            clearTimeout(blurClose)
            let $suggestionsNodes = $this.parent().parent().find(".suggestions-nodesList-box");
            if($suggestionsNodes.find('a').length>0){
                const searchInput = document.querySelector('#searchInput');
                if (searchInput && getCurrentType() !== 'mr') {
                    return
                }
                $suggestionsNodes.show();
            }
        })
        $(".suggestions-nodesList-box").on("click",".suggest-item",function(){
            let parent = $(this).parents('.suggestions-nodesList-box');
            if(parent.is('.suggestions-market')){
                $(".departmentKeyword-inputs").val($(this).attr("data-lable"));
            }else{
                $("#node-nav-label").val($(this).attr("data-lable"));
                $(".suggestions-nodesList-box").html("");
                $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog #node-nav-label-btn').click();
            }
           return false;
        });

        $('#modal-breadcrumb-node-dialog #node-nav-label-btn').unbind('click').bind('click',function(){
            // $('#form-condition-search ul.breadcrumbs-node').empty();
            if($('#form-condition-search #categoryName-checkbox-0').length > 0) $('#form-condition-search #categoryName-checkbox-0').click();
            var nodeLabel = $('#node-nav-label').val();
            if($('#node-nav-label').val()){
                fLoadNode(null, null, true);

        //标签管理
        var clearTagsEditMessageShow = function($mybootBox){
            $mybootBox.find('#showTagsEditError').html('');
            $mybootBox.find('#showTagsEditError').hide();
            $mybootBox.find('#showTagsEditSuccess').html('');
            $mybootBox.find('#showTagsEditSuccess').hide();
        };
        var showTagsEditMessage = function($mybootBox,message,status){
            clearTagsEditMessageShow($mybootBox);
            if(message){
                if(status){
                    $mybootBox.find('#showTagsEditSuccess').html(message);
                    $mybootBox.find('#showTagsEditSuccess').show();
                }else{
                    $mybootBox.find('#showTagsEditError').html(message);
                    $mybootBox.find('#showTagsEditError').show();
                }
                //定时隐藏消息提示
                setTimeout(function(){
                    clearTagsEditMessageShow($mybootBox);
                },500);
            }
        };
        var handleTagsEditData = function($mybootBox,ajax){
            if(ajax && ajax.code==="OK"){
                $mybootBox.find('#table-data-body').html('');
                if(ajax.data && ajax.data.length > 0){
                    $mybootBox.find('#showTagsNoResult').hide();
                    $mybootBox.find('#div-tags-data').show();
                    $("#id_tpl_script_global_tags_data").tmpl({labelItems:ajax.data}).appendTo($mybootBox.find('#table-data-body'));
                    $mybootBox.find('.remarks-tooltip, .tooltip-info, .tooltip-error, .tooltip-success, .tooltip-warning, [data-toggle=tooltip]').tooltip();
                }else{
                    $mybootBox.find('#showTagsNoResult').show();
                    $mybootBox.find('#div-tags-data').hide();
                }
                if(ajax.message){
                    showTagsEditMessage($mybootBox,ajax.message,true);
                }
            }else{
                showTagsEditMessage($mybootBox,'操作失败，请稍后重试！',false);
            }
        };
        var globalShowTagsManageBox = function(){
            //显示修改弹窗
            var $mybootBox = bootbox.dialog({
                message:$('#id_tpl_script_global_edit_tags').html()
            });
            $mybootBox.find('.modal-dialog').css({'min-width':'900px','min-height':'400px','margin-top':'120px'});
            clearTagsEditMessageShow($mybootBox);
            //加载标签数据
            $.ajax({
                type: "post",
                url: "/w/tracking/tag/tags",
                // data:{"clientId":clientId,"allow":allow},
                cache:false,
                async:false,
                dataType: "json",
                success: function(ajax){
                    handleTagsEditData($mybootBox,ajax);
                }
            });
            //合并
            $mybootBox.on('click','[data-action="tagsMergeBtn"]',function(){
                clearTagsEditMessageShow($mybootBox);
                var $parent = $(this).parent().parent().parent();
                var $label = $parent.find('input[name="label"]');
                var $mergeLabel = $parent.find('select[name="mergeLabel"]');
                $.ajax({
                    type: "post",
                    url: "/w/tracking/tag/merge",
                    data:{"label":$label.attr('origin-label'),"mergeLabel":$mergeLabel.val()},
                    cache:false,
                    async:false,
                    dataType: "json",
                    success: function(ajax){
                        handleTagsEditData($mybootBox,ajax);
                    }
                });
            });
            //修改
            $mybootBox.on('click','[data-action="tagsModifyBtn"]',function(){
                clearTagsEditMessageShow($mybootBox);
                var $parent = $(this).parent().parent().parent();
                var $label = $parent.find('input[name="label"]');
                if('DEFAULT' == $label.attr('origin-label')){
                    swal({
                        title: '操作失败',
                        text:'系统未分组标签不支持修改！',
                        type:'error'
                    });
                    return false;
                }
                var $mergeLabel = $parent.find('select[name="mergeLabel"]');
                $.ajax({
                    type: "post",
                    url: "/w/tracking/tag/merge",
                    data:{"mergeLabel":$label.attr('origin-label'),"label":$label.attr('origin-label')},
                    cache:false,
                    async:false,
                    dataType: "json",
                    success: function(ajax){
                        handleTagsEditData($mybootBox,ajax);
                    }
                });
            });
            //删除
            $mybootBox.on('click','[data-action="tagsDeleteBtn"]',function(){
                clearTagsEditMessageShow($mybootBox);
                var $parent = $(this).parent().parent().parent();
                var $label = $parent.find('input[name="label"]');
                var $mergeLabel = $parent.find('select[name="mergeLabel"]');
                if('DEFAULT' == $label.attr('origin-label')){
                    swal({
                        title: '操作失败',
                        text:'系统未分组标签不支持删除！',
                        type:'error'
                    });
                    return false;
                }
                $.ajax({
                    type: "post",
                    url: "/w/tracking/tag/delete",
                    data:{"label":$label.attr('origin-label')},
                    cache:false,
                    async:false,
                    dataType: "json",
                    success: function(ajax){
                        handleTagsEditData($mybootBox,ajax);
                    }
                });
            });
        };

        //关注弹窗
        function productTagsOp (url, $container, productId, tag){
            var param = {productId:productId, label:tag};
            $.ajax({
                type:'post',
                url:url,
                data:param,
                dataType:'json',
                success:function(ajaxResult){
                    handleTagsData($container, ajaxResult);
                },
                error:function(){

                }
            });
        };

        function handleTagsData ($container, ajaxResult){
            if(ajaxResult && ajaxResult.code === "OK" && ajaxResult.data){
                var product = ajaxResult.data.product;
                var utags = ajaxResult.data.utags;
                $container.html($('#tpl-container-attention').tmpl({utags:utags, product:product}));
                $container.find('.tag-label').unbind('click').bind('click', function(){
                    var productId = $(this).attr('data-id');
                    var tag = $(this).attr('data-label');
                    //移除标签
                    if($(this).hasClass('belong-to')){
                        productTagsOp('/v2/product-research/tags/remove/product-tag', $container, productId, tag);
                    }else{
                        //添加标签
                        productTagsOp('/v2/product-research/tags/add/product-tag', $container, productId, tag);
                    }
                });
                //添加标签
                $container.find('[data-action="createAddTag"]').unbind('click').bind('click', function(){
                    var tag = $container.find('#modal-input-tag').val();
                    if(tag){
                        var productId = $(this).attr('data-id');
                        productTagsOp('/v2/product-research/tags/add/product-tag', $container, productId, tag);
                    }else{
                        swal({
                            title: '操作失败',
                            text:'请输入需要添加的标签！',
                            type:'error'
                        });
                    }
                });
                //标签管理
                $container.find('[data-action="tag-manage"]').unbind('click').bind('click', function(){
                    Custombox.modal.close();
                    globalShowTagsManageBox();
                });
            }else{
                swal({
                    title: '数据获取失败',
                    text:'标签获取失败，请稍后重试！',
                    type:'error'
                });
            }
        }

    function saleTrendChart(){
        var text = $(this).attr('data-y'), $that = $(this), price = $(this).attr('data-price'),currency = $(this).attr('data-currency');
        if (text == null || text == '' || text == '[]') return;
        var ar = eval(text), xdata = [], ydata = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < ar.length; i++) {
            xdata.push(ar[i]['x']);
            ydata.push(ar[i]['y']);
        }
        if (xdata.length < 2) return;

        var c = $that[0];
        c.style.width = '120px';
        c.style.height ='64px';
        var myChart = echarts.init(c);

        var option = {
            tooltip: {trigger: 'axis', formatter:function(params){
                    var t = params[0].axisValue;
                    let v = params[0].data == null ? params[1].data : params[0].data;
                    var dateExp = /[0-9]{4}[0-9]{2}/g;
                    if(t && dateExp.test(t.trim())){t = moment(t.trim(), 'YYYYMM').format('YYYY年MM月');}
                    var c1 = Customer.color[0];
                    var c2 = Customer.color[1];
                    var  v1 = (v && v < 5? '< 5' : Customer.getToolTipValue(v));
                    var  v2 = v && price ? Customer.getToolTipValue((v * parseFloat(price).toFixed(0))): '--';
                    if(v2 && v2 != '--') v2 = currency + v2;
                    return '<div class="my-tooltip text-left">' +
                        '<div>' + t + '</div>' +
                        '<div>' + '<div class="my-tooltip-mark1" style="background-color:' + c1 + ' "></div>' + '<span>当月销量</span>' + '<span class="my-tooltip-value">' + v1 + '</span>' + '</div>' +
                        '<div>' + '<div class="my-tooltip-mark2" style="background-color:' + c2 + ' "></div>' + '<span>月销售额</span>' + '<span class="my-tooltip-value">' + v2 + '</span>' + '</div>'
                        + '</div>';
                }},
            color: ["#FD963C", "#919EF4"],
            xAxis: {
                show: false,
                type: 'category',
                data: xdata
            },
            yAxis: {
                type: 'value',
                show: false,
                boundaryGap: ['1%', '1%']
            },
            series: []
        };
        _setSeries(option, xdata, ydata);

        myChart.setOption(option);
        $that.parent("td").removeClass("echart-line-isLoaing")
    }

    function _setSeries(option, xdata, ydata) {
        let data1 = [], data2 = [];
        let index = xdata.indexOf(moment().format('YYYYMM'));
        if (index == -1) {
            data1 = ydata;
        } else {
            data1 = _fillNull(ydata.slice(0, index), index + 1, xdata.length - index);
            data2 = _fillNull(ydata.slice(index - 1), 0, index - 1);
        }
        option.series.push({
            data: data1,
            symbol: 'none',
            type: 'line',
            lineStyle: {width: 1},
            areaStyle: {
                normal: {
                    color: new echarts.graphic.LinearGradient(
                        0, 0, 0, 1,
                        [
                            {offset: 0, color: '#FDDFC2'},
                            {offset: 1, color: '#FFFFFF'},
                        ]
                    )
                }
            }
        });
        data2.length > 0 && option.series.push({
            data: data2,
            symbol: 'none',
            type: 'line',
            lineStyle: {width: 1},
            areaStyle: {
                normal: {
                    color: new echarts.graphic.LinearGradient(
                        0, 0, 0, 1,
                        [
                            {offset: 0, color: '#BAC3FF'},
                            {offset: 1, color: '#FFFFFF'},
                        ]
                    )
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function _fillNull(arr, index, length) {
        let result = [...arr];
        let nullArr = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            nullArr.push(null);
        }
        result.splice(index, 0, ...nullArr);
        return result;
    }
    // 选择包含其他变体
    function getVariantSymbol(type,type_checked){
        let is_type="";
        if(!type){
            let tdoSymbol = $(".checkbox-variantSymbol").attr("data-tdo-symbol") || 'N';
            is_type = tdoSymbol ? tdoSymbol : conditionChineseStorage(false, 'localStorage-variantSymbol');
            type_checked = is_type == 'N'? true : false;
            $(".checkbox-variantSymbol").prop('checked',type_checked);
        }
        $("input[name=symbol]").val(type_checked ? '':'Y');
        if(type==1){$('.form-symbol-search').submit()}
    }
    // 选择网格模式
    function getShowModeType(type,type_checked){
        if(!type){
            let currentlyShowMode = $(".grid-liebiao-btn").attr("data-currentlyShowMode");
            type_checked = currentlyShowMode ? currentlyShowMode : conditionChineseStorage(false, 'localStorage-showMode-product');
            $(".grid-liebiao-btn").find("span[data-showMode="+ type_checked +"]").addClass("ischecked").siblings().removeClass("ischecked");
        }
        $("input[name=showMode]").val(type_checked=='N' ? '':'Y');
        if(type==1){
            $('.form-symbol-search').submit()
        }
    }
    // 大图模式
    $('.container').on("click", ".custom-checkbox.checkbox-grid-bigpic", function () {
        setTimeout(() => {
        let isChecked = $('#checkbox-grid-bigpic').prop('checked');
        let isType = isChecked ? 'Y':'N';
        $("input[name=showMode]").val(isType);
        conditionChineseStorage(isType, 'localStorage-showMode-product');
        $('.form-symbol-search').submit()
        }, 100);
    })

    function findSource(imageUrl, item) {
        var index = imageUrl.indexOf("/", "https://".length + 1);
        if (index < 0) return;
        var imageType = imageUrl.slice(0, index);
        var imagePath = imageUrl.slice(index);
        var source;
        if (item === '1688') {
            source = "https://air.1688.com/app/1688-global/main-site-channel/landing-page.html?bizType=selectionTool&customerId=sellersprite&outImageAddress="
                + encodeURIComponent(imageUrl);
        } else {
            source = 'https://www.alibaba.com/picture/search.htm?imageType=' + encodeURIComponent(imageType)
                + '&imageAddress=' + encodeURIComponent(imagePath) + '&sourceFrom=SellerSprite';
        }
        source = source.replace("SS200", "SS600");
        window.open(source, '_blank');
    }
</script>

        function getTablesMonth(marketId) {
            let arr = []
            var jsonStr = $('#data-markets-tables-month').html().trim();
            let data = JSON.parse(jsonStr)
            if (data) {
                for (const key in data[marketId]) {
                    if (Object.hasOwnProperty.call(data[marketId], key)) {
                        const element = data[marketId][key];
                        arr.push({label:key,table:element})
                    }
                }
                return arr
            }
            return null;
        }

            //     placement: 'right',
            //     html: true,
            //     template: '<div class="popover market-popover"><div class="arrow"></div><div class="popover-body"></div></div>'
            // });
            // $('body').delegate('.market', 'mouseover', function() {
            //     var data = JSON.parse($(this).parent().attr('value').replace(RegExp("\'", "g"), "\""));
            //     var html = '';
            //     data.forEach(function(item, index) {
            //         html += '<div class="popover-item">'
            //             +   '<div class="bg-white">'
            //             +     '<div class="popover-img" style="background-image: url(' + item.image_url +')"></div>'
            //             +   '</div>'
            //             +   '<p class="text-center ellipsis px-1 pb-0 mb-0">第' + (index + 1) + '名</p>'
            //             + '</div>';
            //     });
            //     html += '</div>';
            //     $(this).attr('data-content', html);
            //     $(this).popover('update');
            //     $(this).popover('show');
            // });
            // $('body').delegate('.market', 'mouseout', function() {
            //     $(this).popover('hide');
            // })

            // 阻止跳转
            $("a[data-go-market-research-detail]").click(function () {
                const promotionUser = $('#promotionUser').val() === 'true' ? true : false

                if ($(this).parent().hasClass("guested") && !promotionUser) {
                    $(this).removeAttr('href');
                    // $(this)[0].preventDefault();
                    $('#modal-prevent').show();
                }
            })

            $("#modal-prevent").find('.modal-close').click(function () {
                $('#modal-prevent').hide();
            })

            // 导出到excel
            $('#list-export-reversing').click(function () {
                //减少导出次数
                // reduceTheNumberOfExport($(this));
                //减少导出次数
                // var $form = $('#form-condition-search'),
                //     _search = $form.attr('action');
                // var action = '/v2/market-research/list-export/batch';
                // $form.attr('action', action);
                // $form.submit();
                // setTimeout(function () {
                //     $form.attr('action', _search);
                //     refreshDownloadNum()
                // }, 200);
                var $form = $('#form-condition-search'),
                    _search = $form.attr('action');
                var action = '/v2/market-research/list-export/batch';

                // 使用fetch API
                fetch(action, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: new FormData($form[0])
                })
                    .then(response => {
                        if (response.ok) {
                            // 从Content-Disposition头中提取文件名
                            const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('content-disposition');
                            let filename = 'export-file.xlsx'; // 默认文件名

                            if (contentDisposition) {
                                const filenameMatch = contentDisposition.match(/filename[^;=\n]*=((['"]).*?\2|[^;\n]*)/);
                                if (filenameMatch && filenameMatch[1]) {
                                    filename = filenameMatch[1].replace(/['"]/g, '');

                                    // 处理URL编码的文件名（如果有）
                                    try {
                                        filename = decodeURIComponent(filename);
                                    } catch (e) {
                                        console.warn('Failed to decode filename:', e);
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            // 返回blob和文件名
                            return response.blob().then(blob => ({ blob, filename }));
                        }
                        throw new Error('Network response was not ok.');
                    })
                    .then(({ blob, filename }) => {
                        // 创建下载链接
                        var url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                        var a = document.createElement('a');
                        a.style.display = 'none';
                        a.href = url;
                        a.download = filename; // 文件名
                        document.body.appendChild(a);
                        a.click();
                        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                        document.body.removeChild(a);

                        // 调用完成回调
                        refreshDownloadNum();
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        console.error('Export failed:', error);
                    })
                    .finally(() => {
                        $form.attr('action', _search);
                    });
            });

            // 保存查询模式 MR=选市场
            window.ModuleCustomPreset.init('CN', 'MR');
        });
        var clearNoNum = function (obj) {
            obj.value = obj.value.replace(/[^\d.]/g, ""); //清除"数字"和"."以外的字符
            obj.value = obj.value.replace(/^\./g, ""); //验证第一个字符是数字而不是
            obj.value = obj.value.replace(/\.{2,}/g, "."); //只保留第一个. 清除多余的
            obj.value = obj.value.replace(".", "$#$").replace(/\./g, "").replace("$#$", ".");
            obj.value = obj.value.replace(/^(\-)*(\d+)\.(\d).*$/, '$1$2.$3'); //只能输入两个小数
        }

        $('a[name="switchVisible"]').click(function(){
            $('.filter-condition').toggle();
            $(this).html($('.filter-condition').is(":visible") ? '隐藏过滤条件<i class="iconfont icon-unfold"></i>' : '展示过滤条件<i class="iconfont icon-pack-up"></i>');
        });
            // 表单提交拦截
        function formOnSubmit() {
            const $form = $("#form-condition-search");
            const isNav = $form.find(".change-category").hasClass("isNav");
            if (isNav) {
                $form.find("input[name='departmentKeyword']").val('');
            } else {
                $form.find("input[name='nodeIdPath']").val('');
            }
            return true; 
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const departmentKeyword = urlParams.get('departmentKeyword');
            if (departmentKeyword) {
                const input = document.querySelector('input[name="departmentKeyword"]');
                if (input) {
                    input.value = departmentKeyword;
                }
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>

</html>
